name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6e1567a9fb34b159aacd69f435b93c7&_e=N8iwfSF00Av5nXbpL1D2VFFKDYgQwuICXFQF6F6NJ3zzcTMF3JSgchvr6J1JYxbe6G_pD2H3IngWjYdwDTnqS_iPapY-Q9lJBGkBYAeSMwdvf5H2GLGciz4lSgrMWvbwesLvWuSyj0Dasmxgv6hdWvy73jU7sUlrNIqDykvja0Dh30v11rq-l9yWf5epU2jgKVfbbpk7FXfGkNcAPi1qxNDI0oNHvwFSWDw4erMMfTVwxtsWyJQR9kP25-9fM7lKR4CcHaHsxEL4J8Xhe_2M7FSwy0lYprbJSPlP6PIyCuX-VohZxn__KzO6uo1leFFyh6WFE9gk4jmw_nHkhaesE50cwgE1AUKi5HaB6Jz1_ocCpUoMT-ezrVlJWhghCONnIyGcLILlegAOjtPzIS_lAg%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e6e1567a9fb34b159aacd69f435b93c7&_e=N8iwfSF00Av5nXbpL1D2VFFKDYgQwuICXFQF6F6NJ3zzcTMF3JSgchvr6J1JYxbe6G_pD2H3IngWjYdwDTnqS_iPapY-Q9lJBGkBYAeSMwdvf5H2GLGciz4lSgrMWvbwesLvWuSyj0Dasmxgv6hdWvy73jU7sUlrNIqDykvja0Dh30v11rq-l9yWf5epU2jgKVfbbpk7FXfGkNcAPi1qxNDI0oNHvwFSWDw4erMMfTVnTGhitdgABLE-_q1aJq3ZiPMsrPYLmmARaO_9r-_fkZOCA1O5eGIl4Sckv9Q11jp0JfiQ7aIjJqUl2VVjD_2nrwDMzXrQ-J6YTeQZbXogH6Z4FPiWaiPJzj9FepCkYS0ecDFUwYCrgp0DR_uDhapi8sEs01Ke-RBXstYPfFWIdg%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a8a7f5f08a4542d2a80d80cc13a17f28&_e=RbO2dRHV54UguHxN74HTOAvt_LrtACVrQwu9E8CzuVXH5a3j-4sl0TdNNStsu5svuGSJs4TgIzuQNULYlIPCouqxFW9LPge-RdS9nYxI-9g3eg4m0ke9mZA_WCEybxyGq6rH3vJAoPK_bTFKIef2p1LqZTQLWfi7-5CUhnH4m-WlG9ekUusoqBhAjcPpKNZeZW3zHaoMz5Wezoq2Z06KIcvjityfYN3XpxytqFFUqN30qGyrDVTed2flmUf58de7lo25ax1czPg0pDkY8WD_ElaWosyZY6lvPM4r80TfS-tv5FAkyxU8QahQwMUZOGSLNT-qjpZG0Fj87xGhzimGfmhCDXQ0EOVOzjxVahK1_IUw5x1xDVck5SoySnpqEPYoQuPBFrZt8On6ajYHaMFTdQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a8a7f5f08a4542d2a80d80cc13a17f28&_e=RbO2dRHV54UguHxN74HTOAvt_LrtACVrQwu9E8CzuVXH5a3j-4sl0TdNNStsu5svuGSJs4TgIzuQNULYlIPCouqxFW9LPge-RdS9nYxI-9g3eg4m0ke9mZA_WCEybxyGq6rH3vJAoPK_bTFKIef2p1LqZTQLWfi7-5CUhnH4m-WlG9ekUusoqBhAjcPpKNZeZW3zHaoMz5Wezoq2Z06KIcvjityfYN3XpxytqFFUqN2akeN6nSLEKnRPv7Za7vWo-j1RhAlKMw-RMukWOBnJHSIM8AIEfXd72f-4wcb_COEHgnlqwf5CWi1VHGoeYwkvm29mg2i9iyIrrGE4kqFnFD_BKZZ-tu3MLVPGs-4G6e6KvtlhGmbdq45e58xPgVQlQMD4mOSzoUmy48C42Mb0xw%3D%3D)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=a8a7f5f08a4542d2a80d80cc13a17f28&_e=RbO2dRHV54UguHxN74HTOAvt_LrtACVrQwu9E8CzuVXH5a3j-4sl0TdNNStsu5svuGSJs4TgIzuQNULYlIPCouqxFW9LPge-RdS9nYxI-9g3eg4m0ke9mZA_WCEybxyGq6rH3vJAoPK_bTFKIef2p1LqZTQLWfi7-5CUhnH4m-WlG9ekUusoqBhAjcPpKNZeZW3zHaoMz5Wezoq2Z06KIcvjityfYN3XpxytqFFUqN2IE2cvBoTBqskHnlqVcW0AT8PGMt4cQ9R7zo3Nv6H6wpNhVHtR91XZG4O3xDWIuSFH8sTtoDJUn6P_O4QjEpQ98mOXEWcIX2TpTmI6Tn6K4ITFHH8dZePPBB1m1oW3N1VKeSel4DJ-kvx21h2berrDnXMY3OPODm7oZcbGVtUxow%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61756694:6xuWrQGNa:m:1:3331421248:2405059840D9A84B63A28AE812FDAEC2:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61756694:6xuWrQGNa:m:1:3331421248:2405059840D9A84B63A28AE812FDAEC2:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61756694:6xuWrQGNa:m:1:3331421248:2405059840D9A84B63A28AE812FDAEC2:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61756694:6xuWrQGNa:m:1:3331421248:2405059840D9A84B63A28AE812FDAEC2:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
A brand-new poll from the gold-standard Des Moines Register shows I am only THREE points behind Grassley polls, so of course, I’m facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 48 hours until one of our most important fundraising deadlines of the entire campaign, and right now we’re still short of our $250,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**

If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. A brand-new poll from the gold-standard Des Moines Register shows I am only THREE points behind Grassley polls, so of course, I’m facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. name: Rep. Dana Criswell
subject: Results of ESG Action
body:
Congratulations, You Made a Difference Last week, the Mississippi Freedom Caucus published an Action Center Alert asking Mississippians to contact state treasurer David McRae about ESG investments | |
---

| | | Congratulations, You Made a Difference |
---|---|---
| Last week, the Mississippi Freedom Caucus published an Action Center Alert asking Mississippians to contact state treasurer David McRae about ESG investments.In that publication written by Freedom Caucus Steering Committee member John Williams, we learned that
> “ESG stands for Environmental, Social, and Governance, and, generally, it means that a company’s first concern should no longer be how much money it makes, but rather how much social good it does. In other words, “woke investing.”
John concluded his article by stating,
> “In 1776, we fought a revolution, not between Republicans and Democrats, but between the idea of a system of citizens engaging in self-governance versus a system of enlightened elites deciding behind closed doors what’s best for society at large. ESG is the 21st century embodiment of everything we fought against in 1776 and a precursor to Marxism.”
Through the Mississippi Freedom Caucus [Action Center](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/JzW3Ex5BpLgw7MQnPBU0jg), you took action and contacted state treasurer David McRae. You emailed him asking that he follow the lead of other state treasurers and withdraw any money the state of Mississippi has invested in companies who follow ESG investment strategies. **McRae listened! ** On Friday, Mississippi State Treasurer McRae released a statement opposing any ESG standards. In his statement he says,
> ### _“**I remain strongly opposed to the ESG movement and will do all I can to protect Mississippi from its impact,” **_
[Read McRae's full statement.](https://www.votervoice.net/BroadcastLinks/TQ1C3jdLR1BeMq9b_PvUMA)Thank you for taking a stand and voicing your opinion. You made a difference, you have a voice in your government and by your actions Mississippi has taken a stand against ESG investment practices.The goal of the Mississippi Freedom Caucus is to give you that voice, to help you exercise your rights and make your opinions and wishes known.
You won! Mississippi is a better state because of your actions.
|

You see, the funds that supporters like you generously contribute to our campaign empower us to pay our incredible staff, reach key swing voters, run ads on the air, and make sure our message is heard loud and clear across this state.

It's about what Eric Schmitt is doing – namely, calling up his far-right megadonors to have them launch even more attacks against our campaign. **We have to be ready to compete with him on the airwaves and on the ground in these final days. Help protect Georgia’s Senate seat and elect Democrats up and down the ballot nationwide. | | Derek, in January 2021, Democrats won the Georgia Senate runoff elections, securing a slim 50-50 Senate majority. Thanks to millions of grassroots folks like you, we removed Mitch McConnell as Majority Leader and got Washington working for the American people again. Now, not even two years later, a recent poll puts my reelection race at 46% - 46%. Dead even. With just 10 days until Election Day -- and with many Georgians casting their ballots right now -- I need your support. We still need to reach crucial voters across the state, and my campaign can’t do that without the necessary resources, so I’m asking: Will you split a $10 contribution between my reelection campaign and the DNC before Monday's deadline to support Democrats nationwide? Control of the Senate could very well come down to Georgia, and your support in this moment is absolutely vital. I've been reflecting on this people-powered movement and everything we've accomplished -- and I am filled with immense gratitude. Together, we defied all odds when we flipped this seat last year -- not only delivering Democrats a critical Senate majority, but also making history by electing me as the first Black senator to represent Georgia. In the year since, it has been the honor of my life to build a better, brighter future for our children. But these critical fights for justice aren't over, and I'm once again counting on grassroots supporters like you to power this movement to victory: ** It's an honor to fight for you and beside you. Friend,
In just a few days, we will close the books on the final - and most important - end-of-month fundraising deadline of our re-election campaign.
Our strength to defend this seat hinges on whether we receive enough grassroots donations before this critical deadline.
**With national Republicans actively targeting me for defeat, we cannot afford to be in a position of weakness.**
My opponent has been at one megadonor fundraiser after another. She's been courted by Ronna McDaniel and Rick Scott - heads of the RNC and Senate GOP campaign arm, respectively. She's been at Mar-a-Lago with Donald Trump, raking in huge sums of money for her campaign.
Meanwhile, a right-wing super PAC affiliated with my opponent has launched a misleading smear campaign against me across the airwaves.
So we've increased our fundraising goals to make sure we can fight back effectively and keep this seat blue. I've asked this team to come through in tough moments before, and I know you'll do it again. I know you care too much about Democratic control of the Senate to do otherwise. **[So please, ahead of the final and most important end-of-month deadline of this election, can you donate $5- or whatever you can spare - to help me hit this goal, protect Connecticut's seat, and defend control of the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1283-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick

clean_body: | | | | | Friend, I'm a cattle rancher, a husband and father, a businessman, and a seventh-generation Tennessean. At my company, I worked with electricians, pipe fitters, and plumbers for decades. I spent much of my life working to improve the lives of the 1,200 hardworking folks at Lee Company. Now, I 'm focused on improving Tennessee for the 6.9 million families building their own American Dream in our state. And I believe that dream starts with safety. Some 'leaders' across the country think defunding the police will somehow solve crime and make folks safer. I am NOT one of those people. That 's why my administration launched a $100M Violent Crime Intervention Fund to fight crime in Tennessee... by extending more resources to our brave law enforcement officers. | | | | Friend, crime is on the rise across the country, and part of that is due to the fact that law enforcement officers are quitting at alarming rates in far-Left cities that "defund the police." We 're doing things much differently. We 're showing our respect for the thin blue line here in Tennessee, bolstering public safety and recruiting officers from unwelcoming states to join our force in the Volunteer State. | | | | I believe that the primary function of government is to provide security to the people of the state, especially at a time when the border is wide open to violent criminals and deadly drugs. As Governor, I'll never stop working to make Tennessee a better, safer, and more family-friendly place to live... and I would be honored to have your support. My campaign 's FINAL end of month deadline before the election is just days away, and we're still a bit short of our goal. Hi friend, I am reaching out myself before our final end-of-month deadline to ask a favor of you.
My race for U.S. Senate is one of the most competitive races in the entire country. **At least three different pollsters in recent weeks have released polls that show our race tied, and _CNN_ says North Carolina is one of the three seats “most likely to flip” to Democrats.**
Our campaign is throwing out the old playbook and running the kind of grassroots campaign it takes to win in North Carolina. It’s clear that our strategy is working.
But this is a significant undertaking. It’s not cheap to organize everywhere and make sure voters – from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike – all hear that we understand their hopes and needs.
I’m grateful for this team. The outpouring of support means the world to me. I sincerely mean it, and I hope you know that I do not make these asks lightly.

| Hi Peter, I’m so grateful for Representative Hakeem Jeffries’ support – his support as a Congressman and Chair of the House Democratic Caucus means a lot. clean_body: It’s really close, but there’s also a lot of opportunity. | | Peter--new poll: Josh Shapiro 43 Doug Mastriano 40 Undecided/Other 17 Our campaign hasalmost entirely closed the gap between Doug and Josh Shapiro... but here’s where it gets interesting: The number of “Undecided Voters” has skyrocketed , which is rare so late in the race... ...and most of these currently-undecided voters are actually people who used to support Shapiro in earlier polls... but now aren’t so sure. So here’s what that tells us, Peter: a huge number of voters have lost trust in Josh Shapiro... but they haven’t yet been won over by Doug. You and I both know that Doug’s message resonates with every voter who keeps an open mind about him (like the 17% of Pennsylvania voters who haven’t made up their mind in this race.) All we need to do is get our message in front of them, but we need bigger guns to do it before Election Day. Our campaign has set one FINAL End-of-Month Deadline... of raising $250,000 more online, in the next 72 hours. Hi, friend. It's Val Demings.

I don't get downtime that often, but when I do, my husband, Jerry, and I like to go through our old photo albums. We laugh at the horribly out-of-style outfits, get teary at how little our three sons once were and take a moment to acknowledge where we started versus where we are now.
Friend, only in America could our family have achieved this level of opportunity. I'm the Black daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the 1960s South, and I have a real chance at becoming Florida’s next senator.

I owe a large part of my success to Jerry, who has been my partner in crime fighting for more than three decades – but I also owe immense gratitude to grassroots supporters like you.
Thanks to this massive grassroots team, we've been able to outraise Rubio every _single quarter_ and make this race competitive. But we're in danger of falling short of our midnight fundraising goal – and we're running out of time to close the gap.

If I'm honest, I'm worried that missing this goal means losing our momentum to flip Florida blue – because I'm already being outspent in key areas of the state and the latest polling has us slipping.

Dear #VALUE!,
**Britain has now had three different Prime Ministers in eight weeks.** Boris Johnson was replaced by Liz Truss, who has now made way for Rishi Sunak.

**At least in Britain, they don’t wait four years to replace a leader that clearly isn’t up to the job.** They do it in four weeks.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=dcc9ae84b6&e=5703353baa "Britain is not an Example Country")
---
**_Douglas interviewed on MidDays with Gerard Gibert on SuperTalk Mississippi this week to discuss Britain's political climate. _**
| The latest political drama unfolding in London might make an interesting talking point for many in America, but it also seems rather remote and irrelevant. What could any of it mean over here?

**Actually, Britain today provides a useful example of how not to run a county.** Britain faces political turmoil because of bad public policy decisions, and Americans would do well to avoid the same mistakes.

Britain is in a mess because of a bad energy policy, excessive government borrowing and an addiction to ultra-low interest rates.

** 1\. Bad energy policy: The home of the industrial revolution is now committed to phasing out the use of hydrocarbons to produce energy.** The problem is that moving over to renewables is more expensive. Long before the Ukraine war disrupted natural gas supplies around the world, Britain had banned fracking - despite sitting astride some of the richest deposits of shale gas on the planet. Oil companies wishing to invest in new North Sea production were discouraged from doing so. At the same time, no significant investment was made in nuclear.
**So, guess what? Energy prices in Britain are now insanely high.** It is a measure of the extent to which UK energy policy has pushed up the price of energy in Britain that natural gas prices across the Atlantic earlier this year were SIX times higher than in America.

**Anyone in America wanting to copy Britain and Europe’s energy policy should wait and see how they cope with the coming winter first.**

**2\. Excessive government borrowing:** Prime Minister Liz Truss was forced out because her mini-budget tanked. Contrary to what the mainstream media claimed, the tax cuts she proposed were relatively modest. She was proposing to reduce the tax take back to where it had been in 2019. **What really spooked the markets was Truss’ not-so-mini proposal to borrow an additional £200 billion to subsidize the energy bills of every British household and business for the next two years** (Made necessary due to _Bad Energy Policy_ , see item 1 above). **Under Truss’ predecessor, Boris Johnson, Britain had already maxed out the country’s credit card when the government borrowed eyewatering amounts to pay for people to sit at home for months during COVID lockdowns.** Unsurprisingly, that has now left Britain poorer.

**The Biden administration has spent enormous amounts of money by borrowing. Much of the money has been squandered on various boondoggles.** At some point, as in Britain, that cannot continue.

** 3\. Addiction to low-interest rates:** Think of the British economy as a Jenga tower, built by piling cheap credit upon excess borrowing. Successive governments have produced an illusion of prosperity as they pile brick upon brick. Asset prices have shot up, and easy money allowed people to spend money that wasn’t theirs. Liz Truss was like the unlucky Jenga player that moves a brick that makes the whole tower wobble and risks bringing it down. Whoever is Prime Minister in Britain, interest rates are going to rise, and a lot of the economy’s ghost growth will simply disappear. **Britain is merely the first of many countries to feel the painful consequences of a return to ‘normal’ interest rates.

Britain shows what happens when conservatives govern like progressives.** Fashionable theories about climate change and modern monetary theory have clouded the judgment of those that ought to know better. They are about to face a painful awakening.

body:
my important End of Month fundraising goal
#
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-1?refcode=em20221029-7940&refcode2=7940_434096_c-dzso&akid=7940%2E434096%2Ec-dzso)
**Derek, the last major deadline of this election cycle is coming up — and I'm way short of my important End of Month fundraising goal. In the race that will determine Senate control, falling behind this late in the year is not an option. Please, check your supporter record:**
**\-------------**
**SUPPORTER RECORD**
EMAIL: dpwillis67@gmail.com
DONATION STATUS: **PENDING**
SUGGESTED CONTRIBUTION: $5
DEADLINE: 11:59 p.m.
**\-------------**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-1?refcode=em20221029-7940&refcode2=7940_434096_c-dzso&akid=7940%2E434096%2Ec-dzso)
The consequences of falling short of this goal could not be more serious. Polling shows that I’m only _1 point_ behind Marco Rubio — which is why he and national Republicans are desperately attacking and attempting to undermine the 27 years I spent in law enforcement.
**Derek, I need your help to close this fundraising gap so I have the resources to set the record straight. If I can't, Republicans are almost guaranteed to take back the Senate next month.**
I’m confident that, with a team of grassroots supporters as strong as this one, we _will_ flip Florida blue. But first, we need to work together to hit our massive End of Month goal. **There is no other way to fight back against the GOP mega-donors pouring money into this race to defeat me.**
**[Derek, I need you to help me make up this fundraising shortfall before midnight tonight. Please, will you split a donation of $5 or more between John Fetterman and I to help defeat our Republican opponents, flip Pennsylvania and Florida blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-1?refcode=em20221029-7940&refcode2=7940_434096_c-dzso&akid=7940%2E434096%2Ec-dzso)**

Thank you,
Val Demings

Fellow American,

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=0caa9237185e4dd3a4fc69cb77047bb4&_e=gTXdrpE-tNzhIH23AtiSWFlchHFgt0bJT3mq82SUQ9fyCTrG_a7GL28hg4tHMw-4F24rTSkqSKELqb0AZPAGO2DWtdrYfQjj89h47l7_mKqc-maQEk0A6wE8g-GFdOLC2dCeTRHELqdRLOI8O01b5EouIWkB2JJQI-LsZhVAQ8yKpyQ56JfKEONoS3E7vOPY5Y55ulpgxAWOCGef7TerhFae7e4fEmU6rd7l1G3nzsRoQY8B8txKxZhTwMg5mojNzu0-fIhfe0eoCwQI56nZ09O2zezuwjD8tSCoEI5zr2geYE1pkn5opSCrW2iOCGJ8BYT6uNRSk5kCmGOgDFkbF9S873GNuj0TH7ASsNC_w6LNnkPOM_dOXmlEUqkvs9IH-a5jbQygyz04btMQr3qNaxQtl5nY0t_AWRTSmrEPM8miBp0IViWYYy7JDit91XcZb3tFjHkm17V1nyOFO6eVM23iQqRJKd6F3dWoNkPOHvM%3D)

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=0caa9237185e4dd3a4fc69cb77047bb4&_e=gTXdrpE-tNzhIH23AtiSWFlchHFgt0bJT3mq82SUQ9fyCTrG_a7GL28hg4tHMw-4F24rTSkqSKELqb0AZPAGO2DWtdrYfQjj89h47l7_mKqc-maQEk0A6wE8g-GFdOLC2dCeTRHELqdRLOI8O01b5EouIWkB2JJQI-LsZhVAQ8yKpyQ56JfKEONoS3E7vOPY5Y55ulpgxAWOCGef7TerhFae7e4fEmU6rd7l1G3nzsRoQY8B8txKxZhTwMg5mojNzu0-fIhfe0eoCwQI56nZ09O2zezuwjD8tSCoEI5zr2geYE1pkn5opSCrW2iOCGJ8BYT6uNRSk5kCmGOgDFkbFxAde1GefyVyEJFWdHfeACZglDK1E543Tjan_fTn4N2WlfZbVbrtOcaoKp-rmJoizhRCv2ktEZhTkZv92sds1AH3uYKscZLiz-Gtys1e-5efglopkj-QWWhlvrs4X3szz3tzdtIM_GNEmwdYyhzXe-Y%3D)
When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.

_**I refused.**_
Since that day, I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran, gets the benefits and care they earned.
[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=0caa9237185e4dd3a4fc69cb77047bb4&_e=gTXdrpE-tNzhIH23AtiSWFlchHFgt0bJT3mq82SUQ9fyCTrG_a7GL28hg4tHMw-4F24rTSkqSKELqb0AZPAGO2DWtdrYfQjj89h47l7_mKqc-maQEk0A6wE8g-GFdOLC2dCeTRHELqdRLOI8O01b5EouIWkB2JJQI-LsZhVAQ8yKpyQ56JfKEONoS3E7vOPY5Y55ulpgxAWOCGef7TerhFae7e4fEmU6rd7l1G3nzsRoQY8B8txKxZhTwMg5mojNzu0-fIhfe0eoCwQI56nZ09O2zezuwjD8tSCoEI5zr2geYE1pkn5opSCrW2iOCGJ8BYT6uNRSk5kCmGOgDFkbFyDlBVVPq-UIimOzPJT-J0DdyQMnovMofZpWkWwF9Tiq5u1DC37YAWVboDeqAuyg10guiLQxEYcH_QTuJMQzwoiEn-8GVJvYVhSvxZ8MwyXJVSyveZKMCVPQK5TesJQQ90fZdS9U8njtIOpB89HPoS4%3D)
Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=0caa9237185e4dd3a4fc69cb77047bb4&_e=gTXdrpE-tNzhIH23AtiSWFlchHFgt0bJT3mq82SUQ9fyCTrG_a7GL28hg4tHMw-4F24rTSkqSKELqb0AZPAGO2DWtdrYfQjj89h47l7_mKqc-maQEk0A6wE8g-GFdOLC2dCeTRHELqdRLOI8O01b5EouIWkB2JJQI-LsZhVAQ8yKpyQ56JfKEONoS3E7vOPY5Y55ulpgxAWOCGef7TerhFae7e4fEmU6rd7l1G3nzsRoQY8B8txKxZhTwMg5mojNzu0-fIhfe0eoCwQI56nZ09O2zezuwjD8tSCoEI5zr2geYE1pkn5opSCrW2iOCGJ8BYT6uNRSk5kCmGOgDFkbF38Zt8NC6U5x4pyngBvNHJ2yY6uXCPHtRJyx8FAX1sXaNXA5N0mvfjvcN8xMwwu1CsJmYyhZ1rJKxhofVIpXLx8Dp8dOioZLfYXEQoGhT4x5HGBxnJULx4Q5pT3wYyJ7Rrx_k8IuI7q8ICKucwsdm1s%3D)
It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--and won.

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=0caa9237185e4dd3a4fc69cb77047bb4&_e=gTXdrpE-tNzhIH23AtiSWFlchHFgt0bJT3mq82SUQ9fyCTrG_a7GL28hg4tHMw-4F24rTSkqSKELqb0AZPAGO2DWtdrYfQjj89h47l7_mKqc-maQEk0A6wE8g-GFdOLC2dCeTRHELqdRLOI8O01b5EouIWkB2JJQI-LsZhVAQ8yKpyQ56JfKEONoS3E7vOPY5Y55ulpgxAWOCGef7TerhFae7e4fEmU6rd7l1G3nzsRoQY8B8txKxZhTwMg5mojNzu0-fIhfe0eoCwQI56nZ09O2zezuwjD8tSCoEI5zr2geYE1pkn5opSCrW2iOCGJ8BYT6uNRSk5kCmGOgDFkbF47RUuSOSArFNQ_s_9auClmCudKFWX4VbUOsg4DjHLGsfjsPUOBMF_0ql19wVDgNm7shOpDWW3CzIaZwY3KQZzMzSJUNRB09hOZU4PMQynWfPyHHG4P0phBmNOumCbJlAnn160NHOOtK8wkDT_m1tEY%3D)
In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=0caa9237185e4dd3a4fc69cb77047bb4&_e=gTXdrpE-tNzhIH23AtiSWFlchHFgt0bJT3mq82SUQ9fyCTrG_a7GL28hg4tHMw-4F24rTSkqSKELqb0AZPAGO2DWtdrYfQjj89h47l7_mKqc-maQEk0A6wE8g-GFdOLC2dCeTRHELqdRLOI8O01b5EouIWkB2JJQI-LsZhVAQ8yKpyQ56JfKEONoS3E7vOPY5Y55ulpgxAWOCGef7TerhFae7e4fEmU6rd7l1G3nzsRoQY8B8txKxZhTwMg5mojNzu0-fIhfe0eoCwQI56nZ09O2zezuwjD8tSCoEI5zr2geYE1pkn5opSCrW2iOCGJ8BYT6uNRSk5kCmGOgDFkbF323stwF4JEovPDDGbH1Lhm-W30MVClHmKn0GYLej23uvXkfKw7pmsXrE9WTSkX26DVF0AHUKI7ZXSjZmQIQICmjRouH4f7t0iBgd_jWtGx8Lk2daw30dbHOH9CTCXka6afy30_nI6HKmE6oQYAXrEQ%3D)

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

[](http://links.savecarolina.org/u/click?_t=13365b87b52649cc8d23e393a66fd89d&_m=0caa9237185e4dd3a4fc69cb77047bb4&_e=gTXdrpE-tNzhIH23AtiSWFlchHFgt0bJT3mq82SUQ9fyCTrG_a7GL28hg4tHMw-4F24rTSkqSKELqb0AZPAGO2DWtdrYfQjj89h47l7_mKqc-maQEk0A6wE8g-GFdOLC2dCeTRHELqdRLOI8O01b5EouIWkB2JJQI-LsZhVAQ8yKpyQ56JfKEONoS3E7vOPY5Y55ulpgxAWOCGef7TerhFae7e4fEmU6rd7l1G3nzsRoQY8B8txKxZhTwMg5mojNzu0-fIhfe0eoCwQI56nZ09O2zezuwjD8tSCoEI5zr2geYE1pkn5opSCrW2iOCGJ8BYT6uNRSk5kCmGOgDFkbF81RHmm64Z56p8GfoZyW8QhUjDcuudOOMDudG7qVig80h7sdNNT0laeD5p4TuLRq6RqNnqIbFCjZugyrwUen37DgiiVO7aCELu7gE2FeAaM-PKowlg-twSTBqTalJnANnS56IC6Zaw0ZuUwfzrtf7pQ%3D)

body:
Peter, **I am reaching out with a critical request. You can see from the headlines that we are in the fight for our lives in this election to keep Democrats in power in the Senate and House of Representatives and keep the Democratic agenda moving forward. Many races remain incredibly close and will determine whether Republicans take control of one or both chambers of Congress. The final support we provide to our endorsed candidates in tight races right now will make a difference and we need you to join us.**
**The election is only 9 days away and we need your help to have the maximum impact in supporting our candidates that need critical resources RIGHT NOW and our Get Out The Vote (GOTV) efforts. This is a pivotal moment in the election season that requires as much support as possible from advocates like you or we risk letting Republicans take control.** ****[Would you be willing to make a donation to our efforts to keep a Democratic majority? Your support is CRITICAL. Click Here.](https://act.myngp.com/el/yPjM6ywCCcBWfX6oQcuMIbaI1DK7zsy0qqGhyqvxvvM=/2BkXKU-IvLOSDXEcuZLzW9r0d2lQ9kaAhdJTtpbST7c=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes)**** It is make-or-break time in the fight to elect gun safety advocates at the state and federal levels who can make our communities safer from guns, stand up to the NRA, and protect LGBTQ individuals from discrimination and violence. We are in the final days of the election, and we need additional resources to close out strong. Pride Fund helps gun safety candidates by raising money for them, promoting them in social and news media, targeted ads, and mobilizing volunteers on the ground to get out the vote. We have been the deciding factor in several critical races at the federal and state levels. **Over the years many candidates have told us what we know to be true - our work matters and it 's important.** But all the critical work we do requires resources. As a small grassroots organization, every dollar raised helps us advance our mission of electing gun reform advocates who also support LGBTQ equality. body:

[**UPSET LOOMING? Internal poll shows 3 in 4 Tampa Bay area residents unhappy with Rep. Kathy Castor, desperate for change**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5d6fbdbcd4&e=00028e5542)
_A poll conducted in Florida’s 14th Congressional District shows the Republican nominee, James Judge, handily defeating incumbent Democrat Rep. Kathy Castor. Judge was recently endorsed by law enforcement statewide, while Castor has received zero endorsements from law enforcement this election._ TAMPA, Fla. – In a survey conducted by James Judge’s campaign for the U.S. House of Representatives in Florida’s 14th Congressional District, the vast majority of respondents said they plan to vote for Judge in the upcoming Nov. 8 election.Of those surveyed, 72 percent said they plan to vote for Judge on election day. Only 20 percent said they will vote for Castor, while eight percent said they will vote for someone else.Further, 81 percent of respondents said they feel like America is headed in the wrong direction under Democrat leadership. Only 18 percent said they feel like the country is heading in the right direction, while less than one percent said they had no opinion.“As election day draws closer, I am becoming more and more confident that we are going to defeat Kathy Castor,” said Judge. “Americans are clearly unhappy with the current leadership in Washington, including President Biden, Nancy Pelosi and my opponent. They are tired of runaway inflation, massive debt, unimpeded violent crime and wide-open borders.”The internal polling mirrored external polls, showing that the economy is still the number one issue for Americans in the upcoming election cycle.Additionally, 87 percent of those surveyed do not believe they get a good value for their tax dollars. In another question, 92 percent of respondents said the government should reign in spending. When asked if the federal government’s size should be reduced, 77 percent of respondents said the federal government should be smaller.“Americans are worried about being able to pay their bills,” said Judge. “Food costs more, gas costs more – everything costs more than it did before the Democrats took over. The situation we find ourselves in is entirely unnecessary, and our leaders are putting band-aids on the problem. The only reason gas prices aren’t still at all-time highs is because Joe Biden has drained our Strategic Petroleum Reserve. The Democrats are recklessly playing politics with people’s lives.”Judge squares off with Kathy Castor in the Nov. 8 general election.In addition to dominating the internal poll, Judge recently won a straw poll conducted by the Riverview Chamber of Commerce by a margin of four points over his opponent.The survey was conducted among 107 residents of the Tampa Bay area.Judge has been endorsed by several prominent figures and organizations.They include:· Senator Rick Scott (R-FL)· Congressman Brian Mast (R-FL)· Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ)· Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL) retired· Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard· Florida Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri· The Tampa Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats (retired)· Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast· The Community Patriots Tampa· Republican strategist Roger Stone· Chris Chambers, former Congressional candidate and community leader· Matt Becker, small business owner, former SBA White House Deputy Chief, and former Congressional Candidate**About James Judge:
** Judge, a Tampa Bay area native, is the Republican nominee for Florida’s 14th Congressional District. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and was deployed to Iraq in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom while serving in the U.S. Coast Guard. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011 under General David Petraeus. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the National Rifle Association, Veterans of Foreign Wars, the American Legion, the Tampa Propeller Club and the Coastal Conservation Association. The Judges are also long-time, active members of Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

name: Jamal Raad, Evergreen Action
subject: Want to see the Inflation Reduction Act in action?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY EVERGREEN ACTION
body:
Introducing our new series, IRA IRL
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4374?t=2&akid=13110%2E53494%2Eft8-cV) | The Inflation Reduction Act was a massive climate win... but now that it's law, how is it actually changing our country and building our clean energy future? Our new series showcases exactly how the Inflation Reduction Act is taking effect across the country. No matter where you live, this monumental law is providing real, tangible benefits to you and your community in Pennsylvania. **We fought hard for this. Now, let's meet the Inflation Reduction Act..._in real life._**
---
Friend, it's only been two months since President Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law—but it's already a game-changer in so many ways.
* * *
**__The Latest Critical Impact:_ Huge investments in U.S. clean energy jobs and manufacturing_**
What do battery, tech, clean infrastructure, and automotive companies have in common? _They're all bringing jobs back to the U.S. because of the Inflation Reduction Act._
In order to qualify for the IRA's electric vehicle tax credit, Kia, Hyundai, Honda, Toyota, GM, BMW, and more are moving the final stages of their vehicle production lines to the U.S. They're joined by a multitude of other industries.
That sets the U.S. up as a global leader in the transition toward a clean economy—not to mention more jobs, competitive wages, and more investment right here at home.
* * *
**__Quick Hits:_ In just the last two months, the Inflation Reduction Act has provided..._**
* [_$3.1 billion for farm loan relief, including to help farmers hit by climate-driven natural disasters._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4362?t=3&akid=13110%2E53494%2Eft8-cV)

* [_$27 billion for a green bank to fund local communities' energy efficiency programs, community solar programs, and other pollution-reducing initiatives._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4363?t=4&akid=13110%2E53494%2Eft8-cV)

* [_Direct subsidies to lower costs for electric car and battery manufacturers, plus a $7,500 electric vehicle tax credit for consumers._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4364?t=5&akid=13110%2E53494%2Eft8-cV)

* [_Incentives for a new lithium-ion battery recycling facility to ensure a sustainable future for electric vehicles._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4365?t=6&akid=13110%2E53494%2Eft8-cV)

* [_Long-term certainty and a "new era" for the solar industry, which is now projected to triple by 2027._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4366?t=7&akid=13110%2E53494%2Eft8-cV)

* [_Incentives for pollution-free hydrogen vehicles, leading to a $200 million industrial investment in South Carolina._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4367?t=8&akid=13110%2E53494%2Eft8-cV)

And remember—we're just getting started.
Onward,
Jamal Raad
Executive Director, Evergreen Action

| On Monday, I visited our southern border in McAllen, TX where in the last 4 weeks alone nearly 26,000 illegal immigrants passed through the Rio Grande Valley sector of the border. This crisis is being outright ignored by the Biden administration, which is only incentivizing record breaking crossing and some of the most disastrous policies we've ever seen.
It's time for Democrats to get a harsh reality check. Fentanyl is coming across our border in droves, and is now the #1 cause of death in young adults. Cartels are fully enriched by this crisis, gaining more power every day. Enough is enough. I will do everything in my power to secure our border next Congress. This is a bipartisan issue that affects every American, and we need to start acting like it.
When Republicans take the majority this November, we are going to hold this failing administration accountable for their complete dereliction of duty. That's why I'm running for Chairman of the Homeland Security Committee.

I’m running for re-election in the race of my life. It’s neck and neck, and I need your help to pull ahead before November 8.

As Attorney General, I’ve been fighting to help people afford their lives and live with dignity, safety, and respect, especially when they have nowhere else to turn for help.

You may remember that when Derek Chauvin murdered George Floyd in broad daylight, we got him convicted. He is now serving 22 years. We've taken on some of the biggest cases, from Derek Chauvin, to suing Exxon Mobil and the opiods companies

My Republican opponent is a hedge fund lawyer with zero courtroom experience who vowed to “go on offense” attacking reproductive freedom and said he would "take a sledgehammer" to our work protecting consumers from predatory opioid, tobacco, and drug companies.

**But even though Schultz is out of touch and unqualified for the job, here’s what we’re up against:**
* A recent poll from _The Trafalgar Group_ shows me trailing my anti-choice hedge fund lawyer Republican opponent by FOUR POINTS.
* POLITICO is calling me "Minnesota’s Most Vulnerable Progressive."
* Fundraising numbers show we were outraised by Schultz during the last public reporting period.

Peter, I won with the smallest margin of any Minnesota statewide candidate in 2018, and every indication is this race will be even closer.

Here’s the bottom line: If we don’t dig deep and turn this around, an anti-choice hedge fund lawyer will become Minnesota’s next Attorney General.

[The stakes in this race couldn’t be higher, and we’ve never needed your support more. Friend, There are just ten days left until the election. We’re in a tight race, and we need every bit of help we can get. It is critical that we step up our fundraising in order to secure a win. We still have significant money to raise by the end of the month to meet our goal. We know times are tough and money is tight for everyone. Brenda needs your help so she can stand for all of us. Here are ten reasons donating to Brenda is worth the investment: 1\. Brenda slept on the state capitol steps out in the cold for 27 days to ensure all Vermonters would not freeze to death last winter. 2\. She will devote the resources necessary to combat the Overdose Crisis. 3\. Brenda knows that our planet needs bold climate action now. 4\. She doesn’t take money from big corporations, pharmaceutical companies or fossil fuels. 5\. She pushed through key legislation supporting Vermonters with substance use disorder and legislation assisting families who had lost their homes due to the pandemic despite the Republican administration’s opposition. 6\. Brenda has the support of Vermont State Legislators, Governor Howard Dean, Congressman Peter Welch, Becca Balint, Treasurer Beth Pearce, Ben Cohen & Jerry Greenfield, Vermont NEA, Vermont State Employees Association and more. 7\. She[ has a detailed plan](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDPPzVAl8cO0gYyIMWADgMrVRAmvV_P3bg_Xk0HKGRKtRvU55-H3wPZr5KW--zop9KRY_C0_oPCHbm5zrtuRWLUvwwrUdfNCENJQzhNigFm7y_wdYPCMeAFeCh0cLL1C7CWG16qj2Gx-Lkh-AcbVbrNbybqTGsusrd34t9a9rj_Kh-ZcYFmKL7z1KwNDdZAFO3IeTKIoNihKoEhbtDH1ThvTF3PUH9FY3RTpfVgLOkAJomHCeJboAa_bfkDwrJARlJdMA_VLmF45rEumsVG-ysRi8ZpQGqjtjWnRgR4nVgLWHytdaO8legyGQk7-2mD40pzZ1vqWxQyLpfs8ItSSCDMu8IuYYaXEQXki57oPZCazYW8HJ3OSRScDrZgI0AbshiB3hptBkGSEhT6tvHZT_fhw/3qp/rNRKkyLdRki0HM5MPUOmIg/h0/8YnllIUCtD699iIZOXPGdYMcbuo2IAfuU1C78L3-Wz8) to make Vermont a safe haven for reproductive and civil liberties. 8\. She doesn’t take money from big corporations, pharmaceutical companies or fossil fuels. 5\. She to make Vermont a safe haven for reproductive and civil liberties. 8\. Brenda would be the second women Governor and the first single mom and openly bisexual person to hold the office. 9\. She’s endorsed by each of the top three grassroots climate organizations in Vermont. 10\. Brenda has consistently stood up for teachers and state employees when our current Republican Governor put their livelihoods in jeopardy. Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.

**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zs3vu3da4ai1dpfejbht20r65p8e779trsm5287g_rp22sh2s8i66or7c1hm4o74cjh2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!

[Please help me fight for these peaceful January 6 protesters in court with your best gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away.](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z6qgi3jaorm586r6lhqkp8bn7ckb1dm7jfreq0ag_rp22sh2s8i66or7c1hm4o74cjh2bs)

Hi — it’s Marsh, Digital Director on Team Welch.
Right now, we have 10 days left before Election Day. That’s it — **just 10 days.** That’s 10 days to make a case on every possible medium for our progressive priorities, 10 days to mobilize this grassroots team, and 10 days to elect Peter as Vermont’s next senator.
We’ve got a lot going on over these next 10 days, so we’ll be reaching out every day to keep you updated every step of the way. (And, to keep it fun, we’ll also be sharing one fun fact about Peter each day — read to the end to learn today’s fun fact!)
Last week, we announced the launch of our Grassroots Donor Wall, and since then, we’ve also had a lot of fun watching support pour in from folks on the Welch Wagon! [**Check it out, and if you’d like you see your name here, chip in $3 or more:**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4756?t=3&akid=1149%2E61531%2EitjqKf)

We’re so grateful to have you on this team. Everything we’ve accomplished on this campaign is because of your support. And we hope you’ll continue fighting alongside Peter during this final stretch to turn his vision into reality for all of us.
Thanks so much!
Marsh Palin

You know as well as I do why we can't let that happen. The last time Republicans controlled our democratic institutions – headed by McConnell and the impeached former president – was marked by deception, selfishness and every hindrance of progress possible. This period culminated in an attack on democracy itself, sanctioned by many of those who could be part of the Senate majority if Sen. Cortez Masto loses this seat.
The darkness of those years should serve as a reminder for why our Democratic majority is so crucial – but the _hopefulness_ of recent days should be our clarion call. Sen. Cortez Masto and her Democratic colleagues have helmed historic action on infrastructure, climate change, and lowering prescription drug prices. They confirmed the first Black woman to the Supreme Court. And so much more.
**With hope and hard work, we've accomplished a great deal. But with Sen. Cortez Masto down 1 point in the polls and up against more than $55 million in GOP attacks, she needs our help to win. **
[**Let's help Catherine raise $50,000 before her midnight fundraising deadline. Donate $5 – or whatever you can spare – and split your donation between Catherine and Trudy so they win the most important Senate races in the country and save our Democratic majority.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53604189/375950129/-1358896436?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk402-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTI4NmMzMy1iNDU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0OYif4yC8KGVGWuvsNqdTESeweT9eV5p6YpV0nmlqk0=)
I've been an activist most of my life, Peter. I've witnessed our nation confront and overcome a host of consequential challenges. And I've learned that, at such critical junctures of history, we must ask ourselves: _Who do we want to be as a country?_
Do we want to be a country where the very right to bodily autonomy lies in the hands of right-wing extremists? The kind of country where health care and lifesaving medications are so expensive, they are out of reach for countless Americans? The kind of country where outright lies and conspiracies are used to tear down our democracy?
I say _no. No_ to the country that MAGA Republican rule would manifest. No to extremism and attacks on democracy and fundamental rights. **But – and I say this with no exaggeration – this all rides on whether Catherine Cortez Masto wins this battleground Senate race in Nevada.**
Experts at organizations from The New York Times to CNN are reporting that Catherine is the most vulnerable Democratic senator on the ballot, so we urgently need to do our part to help her win. [**Will you please split $5 or whatever you can spare today between Catherine Cortez Masto and Trudy Busch Valentine to save our Democratic Senate majority?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53604190/375950130/-1358896436?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk402-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTI4NmMzMy1iNDU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=0OYif4yC8KGVGWuvsNqdTESeweT9eV5p6YpV0nmlqk0=)
Thank you,
Martin Sheen

Democrats have gone insane with ideological fanaticism, and to put it plainly, the Democratic Party that I joined doesn't exist anymore.

**[Today, I'm proud to endorse John Gibbs for Congress in Michigan's 3rd District.](http://tracking.mail.candidatesnews.com/tracking/click?d=WkFwGbeizDxpsuEQhaQT-KHFv8al4taZeHbxjQP_StEIl71iwG0Kdbqjicix8-_lNsfrcR0USMCnpdqlfZ7Y_qf97B6AqbcXW8YHp_oCuEBvwEv13aOU5rAqT9VV3yjRu1w-qLIM-6copW-rvWFPGjZsAULOn-XunHABb627rRS5c8G_IzYD5Mv5hrBaJKgqObrA31pC2uxWKPTUFqnkY9sTNVHhocl-_WeyNDr8sYJYmzbMufsgGz_-6E9BpPBPFzXkmSQYdtoPcg_Iy-3ZKYPCu-5KSWIJnmOz0nF-4DlWslbF1ylYzQbOjHesVLUnXA2)** John is a leader who puts people first, is fighting for border security, energy independence, public safety, and other policies that actually make life better for the American people.

My parents were married in East Grand Rapids, which is my mother's hometown. This district and John's race matter to me. **[So I hope you'll join me today in supporting John's campaign with a generous gift.](http://tracking.mail.candidatesnews.com/tracking/click?d=WkFwGbeizDxpsuEQhaQT-KHFv8al4taZeHbxjQP_StEIl71iwG0Kdbqjicix8-_lNsfrcR0USMCnpdqlfZ7Y_qf97B6AqbcXW8YHp_oCuEBvwEv13aOU5rAqT9VV3yjRu1w-qLIM-6copW-rvWFPGjZsAULOn-XunHABb627rRS5c8G_IzYD5Mv5hrBaJKgqObrA31pC2uxWKPTUFqnkY9sTNVHhocl-_WeyNDr8sYIcokf2SiD1PSLaWomN1M4v30nDckj2H-rrkmS0XHfRMeOETmy7UB1CnlOh5alTZDzvQjpDAIM3wL4A1jwTElJkVw2)**

John isn't afraid to call out permanent Washington and the propagandists in the mainstream media who aim to keep them in power.

Our country is in desperate need of leaders like John who will stand up for the objective truth and bring the fight directly to the dogmatic fanaticism of ideologues leading the Democratic Party.

**[Please join me in supporting John's campaign here.](http://tracking.mail.candidatesnews.com/tracking/click?d=WkFwGbeizDxpsuEQhaQT-KHFv8al4taZeHbxjQP_StEIl71iwG0Kdbqjicix8-_lNsfrcR0USMCnpdqlfZ7Y_qf97B6AqbcXW8YHp_oCuEBvwEv13aOU5rAqT9VV3yjRu1w-qLIM-6copW-rvWFPGjZsAULOn-XunHABb627rRS5c8G_IzYD5Mv5hrBaJKgqObrA31pC2uxWKPTUFqnkY9sTNVHhocl-_WeyNDr8sYICUVdEexV3csM0oVufs9uNLgs7z7kAc4ezJ8JR5Y874T4A8xcSWlr7hDWqKp216I5qlT_IUuZ0HX5_kZAmQ0YBhg2)**

With aloha,

Tulsi Gabbard

[ ]DONATE NOW TO HELP SEND MORE ALLIES TO CONGRESS! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Minnesota AG Keith Ellison is one of our strongest progressive leaders — and he joined our [ ]National Organizing Call Monday to dig into his tough battle for re-election against extremist Jim Schultz, who wants to criminalize abortion and defund corporate law enforcement. Keith helped led the team that convicted former Minneapolis police officer Derek Chauvin for the murder of George Floyd — and now the far right is coming after him for it. “Help me make it so that if you’re standing up for justice you will not be turned out of office.” “My opponent has tried to make this race all about crime, but he’s offered no good solutions,” Keith told us. “We have a package, a program, to promote safety and security at the AG office.” [ ][IMG] We must make sure Keith can continue his great work taking on the negligent gun retailers, slum lords, and oil companies endangering lives. While Keith fights price gougers, Schultz’s hedge fund employer made [ ]$2.6 BILLION as a pandemic profiteer. While Schultz wants to gut consumer protections, Keith has won more than $300 million for Minnesotans by holding Big Pharma accountable for the opioid epidemic. “We’re working to help people afford their lives and standing up for our rights and freedoms,” Keith said. “My opponent aims to be the fox in the henhouse — inside the institution to stop any effort to help workers and to enrich the most powerful.” [ ][IMG] OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese told [ ]Politico this is a race to watch. “Nationally, you’ve got Republicans running on this tough-on-crime narrative, and Keith is at the epicenter of that. If he is able to fend off the attacks, it’ll give us a pathway on criminal justice reform.” This is a priority race and we need all hands on deck! Doing the people’s work earns you powerful enemies, and Keith is in a fight to the finish. Can you step up for a phone bank shift to help Our Revolution turn out our 147,000 supporters in Minnesota? [ ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Megan Green joined our [ ]LIVE National Call Monday to talk details on her grassroots campaign for President of the St. Louis Board of Alderman. On the board, Megan helped pass a $15 minimum wage and Coatar voted against it. While she supports hotel workers organizing with Unite Here Local 74, her opponent Jack Coatar is taking huge donations from their anti-union bosses. Coatar is the big-money candidate in the race to replace Reed, who is headed to a likely federal prison sentence for taking bribes in development deals. “We have to put an end to this level of corruption that has had a stranglehold on city government,” Megan told us. “We need a city government that is responsive to the needs of the community,” she said. “I brought participatory government to the 15th Ward — people should be able to vote directly on how their dollars are spent and that’s something we can do at the city level to build trust.” [ ][IMG] This race will empower our growing progressive bloc in St. Louis — and we can lend a hand from all across the country. Please join a phone bank shift to get the message out to voters that Megan will fight for housing justice, good union jobs, strong neighborhoods, and more. [ ]MAKE CALLS FOR MEGAN ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] In Arizona, we have progressives Sandra Kennedy and Lauren Kuby running for seats on the little-known but powerful Corporation Commission to regulate utility monopolies, snuff out corruption, and lower energy prices. “The choice for Arizona Corporation Commission is simple,” “We will ensure a clean energy future. Our Republican opponents will not,” Kuby wrote in [ ]AZ Central. “Investing in clean energy also creates local, high-wage jobs that benefit Arizonans while conserving our most precious natural resource: water.” The utilities want to buy these key seats, but we can’t let them handpick their own regulators! [ ][IMG] The electric utility APS spent more than $10M to defeat Sandra in 2014 and raise utility prices, but she came back to beat them in 2018 — and now we can re-elect her and add Lauren Kuby to join her in stamping out corruption! [ ][IMG] Our Revolution is going all out in this critical down-ballot race — and we need your help! Sign up for a shift or two to get these climate champions over the finish line! [ ]PHONEBANK FOR KUBY & KENNEDY ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution is backing Zo Qadri in his race for Austin City Council in District 9. Zo is the son of immigrants and will be the first South Asian and the first Muslim elected to the city council. He joined our [ ]Live National Call Monday evening to talk about how can help beat the crowded field of 8 candidates in this tight race — and what he would do in office. [ ][IMG] Austin’s affordability is on the ballot this year. Zo is committed to fighting for housing, worker rights, equal justice, unions, climate action — and giving everyone a seat at the table. “Austin is letting down its most vulnerable populations — we have a long way to go before we become that progressive city we claim to be,” Zo told us. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] As Election Day nears, OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese told [ ]The Hill: “the closing argument has to be about what matters to the electorate. “In this moment in particular, voters are looking for the candidates who will fight to raise their standards of living.” After running primarily on the important issue of abortion, Democratic Party leaders are now sounding the alarm on Republican plans to dismantle Medicare and Social Security, while cutting taxes for the ultra-wealthy. “The headwinds are against us, so any pivot is timely,” Joseph said in [ ]Yahoo News, “but do I wish that Democrats had articulated a bold economic agenda that was going to be deflationary at the start of the summer? Yes.” “Democrats can’t just run on fear,” Joseph told [ ]ABC News. “Fear is a mobilizing factor, but hope should outweigh it. You have to have something to believe in, something to vote for. That’s what really motivates somebody.” [ ][IMG] The truth is, progressive policies address the root causes of the economic pain so many of us are experiencing — but we can only work to deliver on that agenda if we elect more and better Democrats in this midterm election. From antitrust to reshoring jobs, taxing the wealthy, raising wages, and making healthcare and education free at the point of service — these are the policies that put power and money back in the hands of the people. [ ][IMG] US Rep. Ro Khanna said in [ ]Yahoo News: “I call it a new economic patriotism, which is that Democrats are bringing manufacturing back home. We’re bringing back supply chains, and that actually is going to help tackle inflation.” “The most singular thing progressive voters are looking for is someone who has a bold, progressive vision that is not purely idealistic but is also implementable — and that the candidate also has the ability to organize masses of people to implement that agenda,” Joseph said in the [ ]LA Times. That’s why Our Revolution is joining Bernie to do the work between now and Nov. 8th, and make the case to every voter we can about what’s at stake as well as what we can accomplish if our candidates win. [ ]Chip in now to help fund the direct voter outreach that can be the margin of victory in key swing states! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Progressive Mandela Barnes can take out far-right Senator Ron Johnson in Wisconsin — with our help! He’s in a tough race, but we have a path to victory and can flip this key seat. [ ]MAKE CALLS FOR MANDELA ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Dr. Oz is closing the gap and we can’t let him win! We need YOU to make calls for John Fetterman! Let’s make sure we flip this senate seat, defeat Dr. Oz, and elect a progressive! [ ]CALL FOR FETTERMAN ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] We have to marshal our resources NOW to execute our strategy over the next three weeks to defeat the far right and elect progressives on Nov. 8th. If we connect with each voter 4 times — by phone, text, mail, social media, and door-knocking — we can boost turnout by 11 percent and make a decisive difference in tight races. [ ]DONATE TO OUR EMERGENCY SWING STATE FUND! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Early voting is open and we have a battle on our hands to re-elect Keith Ellison as Minnesota AG and defeat his far-right extremist opponent who wants to criminalize abortion and defund all corporate law enforcement. Keith has taken on corporate price-gouging in the pandemic and led the fight to convict Derek Chauvin for the Murder of George Floyd — let’s make sure he continues his good work as Attorney General. [ ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Lauren Kuby and Sandra Kennedy are consumer watchdogs and climate champions, who we must help win seats on the little-known but powerful Arizona Corporation Commissioner. Let’s make AZ a leader in renewable energy! [ ]MAKE CALLS FOR KUBY & KENNEDY ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Megan Green — a 2016 Bernie delegate we helped elect to the St. Louis Board of Alderman last cycle — is up against union busters and big developer money in her run for board president. body:
I am asking for your support to help defeat Ron Johnson.

---
Friend,
My path to running for U.S. Senate was different than most.
I don't come from a wealthy family. I didn't enter this race with a bunch of megadonors lining up to write big checks to this campaign.
My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift at General Motors. Those jobs were our family's ticket to the middle class.
Ever since I was a little kid, my parents taught me never to settle for what is, but to reach for what can be. It was how I graduated high school at the age of 16 and went on to be elected to the Wisconsin State Assembly when I was 25. And it's how I won Wisconsin’s Lieutenant Governor race in 2018 and helped beat Scott Walker.
Then, after careful thought and consideration, I decided to get in this U.S. Senate race to defeat Ron Johnson.
It was a big decision. I knew that this was going to be one of the most competitive races in the entire country. And it is a race that we must win if we're going to defend and expand the Democratic Senate majority.
I was willing to bet that if I decided to run, people like you would come together in large numbers to help fund this campaign. Because the truth is that no single person can flip Wisconsin's Senate seat alone. It will only happen if we're in this together.
**With $42 million in attack ads against me so far, I urgently need your support in order to have the resources to take on the right-wing super PACs and win in November.**

clean_body: Did you hear what I had to say? Superbowl Canceled? | I love football, but that doesn’t mean I’m going to let the NFL bully Arizona. Besides, in a game of chicken vs. the NFL, I promise you, I’ll win that game. Did you hear what I had to say? | I promise if the NFL takes the side of drug smuggling cartels and opposes our common sense border plan, they can find a new place to host the Super Bowl. If the NFL wants to jam radical left politics onto the field and take the side of criminals, that’s fine. I don’t care who steps in our way, I don’t answer to anyone but the people of Arizona. **If sticking one to the billionaires, stopping the border crisis, and keeping Arizona far away from the corruption of Washington sounds good, I’d be honored to have your support. Best, Kari Lake Candidate for Arizona Governor

body:
We missed our $5,800 goal yesterday by just $716. We're getting on more chance to redeem our $5,800 match, but we have to hit our goal by 11:59 p.m. I know you are busy enjoying what’s left of your weekend, so I’ll try to be quick! |
---
Fellow Conservative

I want to apologize for emailing you twice in one day, but with just 10 days remaining in this election, this couldn’t wait. **Before you click out of this, or God forbid delete the message before reading it in its entirety, please know that your support at this critical juncture could mean the difference between another two years of DEM control in the House or helping it flip Republican.**

I’m nothing if not honest. I have my faults as we all do, but a liar I am not. You likely recall the email that I sent to you yesterday laying out in no uncertain terms that our fundraising this month hasn’t been good at all – in fact, Tuesday marked our single worst day of donations in the last six months. **As a result, a very generous benefactor offered to cut my campaign a check for $5,800 under the condition that I came up with an additional $5,800 from donors like you by midnight last evening**.
**
We failed. In the end, we came up short by $716.[[link to donate]](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9d937aed83cd498092f1f751a45dd590&_e=QeEEzEPdkUzmahIBYIMFB-Prh2tEvM77Z_F5HQVELnMYdjdKT_f6tlUiKt2fCwfBIZFz6jm3_ljKF-gdE5BG2OYpSBbOjDRU5s58Lh-JtQ-LBRaAK-V9TAM_tqNYP97X8lrEMikvvG1StYzDSEP3jECEwBy4oYlC66VPY5mdhJXrJKXQAsOygkhu8Wv_jnp_4eqhOMxCR4JvplWr40Bn5O0Z9CB_B8v1sonSz9VLg4RbZhNF2SgdTSTdbko_QTM2pP7q1FEyef8CTW6KFOLljCksbCxLll0DVH-gDCXSSOSsyhX08cBrHYThpen7DbFt-Jl3mr-n0jhCC2GTDgn5c94D_fcbdYA-xfOaS0biDykEACi2v9UZRCR4784xhnx__N3wW8jN9Pn26JePw_tyjQ%3D%3D) **

All is not lost – yet. The donor, who wishes to remain anonymous, has agreed to give us one more shot at winning his support. If we can come up with the additional $716 by midnight tonight, he’ll follow through with his part of the bargain and cut us the $5,800 check.

**[Can we count on you to help us make up the difference right now? $5, $10, even $15 really will go a long way.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=9d937aed83cd498092f1f751a45dd590&_e=QeEEzEPdkUzmahIBYIMFB-Prh2tEvM77Z_F5HQVELnMYdjdKT_f6tlUiKt2fCwfBIZFz6jm3_ljKF-gdE5BG2OYpSBbOjDRU5s58Lh-JtQ-LBRaAK-V9TAM_tqNYP97X8lrEMikvvG1StYzDSEP3jECEwBy4oYlC66VPY5mdhJXrJKXQAsOygkhu8Wv_jnp_4eqhOMxCR4JvplWr40Bn5O0Z9CB_B8v1sonSz9VLg4RbZhNF2SgdTSTdbko_QTM2Sgk8JvxlySPEqUJRb0hdSUpDOU91S3EwJ5kULt9tR9YKTIVLnNnrxx6BzsL4tCSQ-Atb65Ov98tqtTBV49bHAjbIO99KEl73fv8Rd82N59LCKSvrL3aeJBN4CjpyFspg4IM5jRAMjWNJd3I9KdeXRQ%3D%3D) **

body:
Hello Friends,
Since election ballots started arriving, people have asked me who I support for Secretary of State.
After the primary, I joined Reagan Dunn, Rob McKenna and many Republican county auditors in supporting independent candidate **Julie Anderson**.
She is the only candidate, as the Pierce County auditor, who has experience overseeing elections-- which is the secretary of state's most important job. As a non-partisan elected official in Pierce Co., she irritated local democrats by endorsing Kim Wyman for secretary of state in 2012, and then again in 2016. She is not beholden to any party, and that is the kind of person we need supervising elections.
I will be voting for **Julie Anderson for secretary of state** , and encourage you to join me.
Stay in touch.
Onward,

Bill Bryant

As we always expected, the Republicans are closing strong. They just took the lead in Nevada and Wisconsin and erased our advantage in Pennsylvania -- but donations in these final weeks to pull Democrats back ahead have NOT picked up as much as we expected.

**I’m sorry to say our window of opportunity is closing. The situation is so critical that I've just authorized an _extremely rare_ QUADRUPLE-Impact Match to help close our final budget gap before the election.**

**[Please, I’m personally asking you to make a matched $5 donation today to help protect our Democratic Senate majority.
