There is so much at stake, it can seem overwhelming at times. It helps me to put it in personal terms. A [recent story in the Springfield News-Leader](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53587442/375915614/-1481344?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjAzMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTIyYzA2MS05ZjU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bQzpu1uMP1IAf8RRYfN1a-yOAAzIMZynStPzzjXaxEQ=&emci=f7b577d2-ee56-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=5e22c061-9f57-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=14943357) profiled a woman put through an unthinkable ordeal after her pregnancy tragically became unviable, threatening her health and her life. Declining to provide a medically necessary and life-saving abortion, multiple hospitals cited the vaguely written abortion law that Missouri Republicans like Ann Wagner fought for, and that Senate candidate Eric Schmitt initiated without delay following the Supreme Court's _Dobbs_ decision. While her unborn baby was dying inside of her, a baby that she and her partner wanted and prepared for,**this woman was forced to seek life-saving care at her own expense, outside of Missouri**. She even tried enlisting help from her state senator and Attorney General Schmitt, explaining over the phone (in excruciating detail) the private and intimate medical situation she was in to no avail. Her state senator ultimately referred her to a crisis “pregnancy center,” which do not perform abortions, and AG Schmitt never responded to her pleas for help or clarification on the law he proudly activated. So, when you hear that Democrats are trying to make this election about abortion, remember the suffering this woman endured because politicians recklessly imposed their moral views on her body. And remember that they will do it again and again and again, shaving away freedoms until we’re all affected. When you hear that "Democrats want to kill babies, both during pregnancy and after," imagine how you’d feel if you were a patient seeking care for a life-threatening ectopic pregnancy, yet being called a murderer. If stories like this disgust and enrage you, you are not alone. No matter what happens in November, we need to stand together and fight for a tolerant and free America that respects individual privacy. clean_body: Peter, This election is about so much: protecting basic civil rights like voting, reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy, the cost of living for American families, and safeguarding free and fair elections. There is so much at stake, it can seem overwhelming at times. It helps me to put it in personal terms. A profiled a woman put through an unthinkable ordeal after her pregnancy tragically became unviable, threatening her health and her life. Declining to provide a medically necessary and life-saving abortion, multiple hospitals cited the vaguely written abortion law that Missouri Republicans like Ann Wagner fought for, and that Senate candidate Eric Schmitt initiated without delay following the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision. While her unborn baby was dying inside of her, a baby that she and her partner wanted and prepared for,this woman was forced to seek life-saving care at her own expense, outside of Missouri. She even tried enlisting help from her state senator and Attorney General Schmitt, explaining over the phone (in excruciating detail) the private and intimate medical situation she was in to no avail. Her state senator ultimately referred her to a crisis “pregnancy center,” which do not perform abortions, and AG Schmitt never responded to her pleas for help or clarification on the law he proudly activated. So, when you hear that Democrats are trying to make this election about abortion, remember the suffering this woman endured because politicians recklessly imposed their moral views on her body. And remember that they will do it again and again and again, shaving away freedoms until we’re all affected. When you hear that "Democrats want to kill babies, both during pregnancy and after," imagine how you’d feel if you were a patient seeking care for a life-threatening ectopic pregnancy, yet being called a murderer. If stories like this disgust and enrage you, you are not alone. No matter what happens in November, we need to stand together and fight for a tolerant and free America that respects individual privacy. In Solidarity, P.S. **Friends & Fellow Parents,**
If you’re like me, you have fond memories of trick or treating – whether as a child yourself or with your own children. You knew which houses had the full-sized candy bars and which to skip so you didn’t end up with a box of raisins. There were the houses that had pumpkins that looked like they were carved by a professional artist and others with the spookiest decorations!
**Unfortunately, there’s a scarier issue at hand.** The DEA and local health departments are warning parents and guardians to beware of “rainbow fentanyl” on the rise during this year’s Halloween festivities...a deliberate attempt by drug cartels to market drugs to our children. This highly addictive and dangerous drug comes in the form of rainbow-colored pills and has recently been found in Skittles, Nerds and SweeTart packaging.
**While experts suggest it is unlikely the drug will end up in your children’s Halloween candy, health departments across Connecticut have recommended parents should remain vigilant.** As we watch local officials take action, my opponent has done nothing to thwart the current fentanyl crisis at the border or in our district.
**When I am your next Congresswoman I will protect our children** and address the lack of security at our border, and put an end to the cartels pushing illegal and dangerous drugs into our country, exacerbating the already full-blown opioid emergency across the country and in our communities.
**In the meantime, please stay safe and have a very happy Halloween with family and friends.**

clean_body: | | | | There's a scarier issue at hand right now... jaymestevensonforcongress.com Friends & Fellow Parents, If you’re like me, you have fond memories of trick or treating – whether as a child yourself or with your own children. You knew which houses had the full-sized candy bars and which to skip so you didn’t end up with a box of raisins. There were the houses that had pumpkins that looked like they were carved by a professional artist and others with the spookiest decorations! Unfortunately, there’s a scarier issue at hand. The DEA and local health departments are warning parents and guardians to beware of “rainbow fentanyl” on the rise during this year’s Halloween festivities...a deliberate attempt by drug cartels to market drugs to our children. This highly addictive and dangerous drug comes in the form of rainbow-colored pills and has recently been found in Skittles, Nerds and SweeTart packaging. While experts suggest it is unlikely the drug will end up in your children’s Halloween candy, health departments across Connecticut have recommended parents should remain vigilant. As we watch local officials take action, my opponent has done nothing to thwart the current fentanyl crisis at the border or in our district. When I am your next Congresswoman I will protect our children and address the lack of security at our border, and put an end to the cartels pushing illegal and dangerous drugs into our country, exacerbating the already full-blown opioid emergency across the country and in our communities. In the meantime, please stay safe and have a very happy Halloween with family and friends. Thank you for the support! I don't know that there's a more important moment, in a more important place than what's happening in Texas today.

[Please split a contribution between Ron Be Gone and my campaign right now. It’ll help make sure that we have the resources to reach the voters who are going to decide the outcome of the most important governor's race in America.](https://act.ronbegone.com/go/13299?t=10&akid=1526%2E564421%2E0Ei4YZ)

It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm.

During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it had sold for before. **Abbott's biggest campaign contributors ended up making billions of dollars over the course of those five days.** The kicker is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result.

This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas.

This week marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers were killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy not one but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the worst mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years, and the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets.

What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in August. It begins at conception with no exception for rape or incest. This is happening in a state that leads the country in this crisis of maternal mortality that is three times as deadly for Black women. We absolutely know this is going to cause more suffering and death in the state of Texas.

The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. **But the way that Texans are responding is incredibly inspiring and fills me with optimism and a lot of confidence that we're going to win this fight on November 8th.**

People are not accepting this, they're not submitting to it, and they're not succumbing to the temptation to despair. They're taking action and they're showing up.

[Will you join our growing effort to win this election, overcome these challenges, and get Texas on the right track by splitting a $10 donation today between Ron Be Gone and my campaign? Folks,
I know some of us may not be able to vote in person — early or on November 8. If you’re planning to vote by mail this season, **TODAY, October 29,** is the last day to request your mail-in ballot. Here are a few reminders to make sure you vote on time, and that **YOUR VOTE IS COUNTED.**
* Order your mail ballot by calling your county Supervisor of Elections office and requesting a mail ballot no later than **October 29.**
## **_[Make Your Plan to Vote](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53618479/375966851/-1612268846?refcode=20221029.01_org_em_gotv&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTYxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMmQwM2Q0Ny1jNDU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qz-PLeZRXA2dGUfbF8fwiCStlD9kS5z_mU3sj13FIIY=&emci=144c096c-bd57-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=f2d03d47-c457-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=8807089)_**
* Once you’ve filled out your mail ballot, be sure to **sign your name** on the signature line on the outside of the provided return envelope or your vote will not count!
* Mail ballots MUST be received by the Supervisor of Elections office no later than 7pm on November 8. Concerned about your mail ballot arriving too late? You can **drop off your ballot** at a local Supervisor of Elections office or go vote in person.
* If you decide to vote in person, you do **NOT** have to bring your mail ballot with you.
* If you experience any problems with voting by mail, please call the Voter Assistance Hotline at 1-833-VOTE-FLA (1-833-868-3352).

If everyone makes a plan with friends & family, and we all pledge to vote, we can win this thing. Thanks again for your support — let’s win this Florida.
– Charlie Crist

subject: Were you not raised to respect your elders?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
some older Americans are saying they can now only afford one meal per day.
Fellow American

Joe Biden’s inflation is hitting our senior communities especially hard as some older Americans are saying they can now only afford one meal per day.

Many seniors in America live on a fixed income, often Social Security, which totals just $1,657 per month.

And we're defending him in court!

| | | Peter, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. **With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming.** Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. [**Can I count on your best gift of $40 or more to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND to help us give him the legal defense he deserves?**](http://post.conservativeum.com/rd/9z2zq1n6f67lcmfibjtgo6r13kh3q3fmb95qrrsh6no_rp22sh2s8j6ap30spie2o724no) Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, **a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son 's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways**. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act...** _and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family._** We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. [**That 's where your emergency donation to the MARK HOUCK DEFENSE FUND comes in - by giving today you can stand with Mark in his hour of need.**](http://post.conservativeum.com/rd/9z2z5bifohhm6hsddler6ifvv1dnueqcp7v9gl87458_rp22sh2s8j6ap30spie2o724no) Make no mistake, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, **_Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn 't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone. _** Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. clean_body: And we're defending him in court! | | | Peter, I need your immediate support to help the Thomas More Society defend a father-of-seven pro-life advocate against false criminal charges. Please let me explain. In the early morning of September 23, roughly twenty-five FBI agents wearing tactical gear threatened to break down the door of Mark Houck's home if he didn't let them in immediately. With guns pointed at Mark, they hauled him off to jail while his wife and kids looked on, screaming. Now he's facing multiple criminal charges and eleven years in federal prison due to an incident involving an aggressively abusive Planned Parenthood escort - which is why our team is representing him in court. Mark is a dedicated pro-life author, speaker, and sidewalk counselor. He would drive two hours every week to stand outside of abortion clinics for six to eight hours at a time, praying the Rosary and offering support to women who are so desperate they think they have no alternative than to abort their babies, often bringing his twelve-year-old son. But one day, a Planned Parenthood escort got in his young son 's face, ridiculing him and his father in very vulgar and aggressive ways. Mark defended his son by shoving the escort away after having repeatedly asked him to stop the abuse. The escort wanted him prosecuted for assault and battery for shoving him away from Mark's young son, but the District Court of Philadelphia threw out the case. So, Biden's Department of Justice charged Mark with violating the federal FACE Act... and now this courageous pro-life hero faces up to eleven years in federal prison for advocating for life and for defending his family. We're pulling out all the stops to make sure the DOJ and the abortion clinic escort who are trying to destroy Mark and his family don't get away with this. But this is going to be a long, costly affair, and I need your help. Make no mistake, Mark's arrest was a targeted attack specifically intended to intimidate pro-lifers and people of faith. The incident at the abortion clinic was so minor that the authorities refused to press charges and when the escort filed charges himself, his case was thrown out. Fortunately for Mark and his family, if anyone has experience defending pro-life heroes against Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood, it's us. My name is Tom Brejcha and I'm the president and chief counsel of the Thomas More Society - the not-for-profit law firm defending Mark Houck. We're proud to have defended many renowned leaders in America's pro-life movement such as Joe Scheidler and the Pro-Life Action League, David Bereit, David Daleiden, Shawn Carney and 40 Days for Life, Abby Johnson, the Susan B. Anthony List, Lila Rose and Live Action, the March for Life, and many more. But without the help of generous donors, none of our crucial work would be possible. Because the reality is, while you can't be the one personally defending Mark in the courtroom, by donating you can help us vindicate this brave father and pro-life hero who is being ground through the system in an unjust prosecution. I will be grateful for whatever you're able to send today. Whether it's $10, $40, $60, $250 or more... ...because time is of the essence. We're expecting Mark's defense to cost us hundreds of thousands of dollars. To put it as bluntly as possible, Mark could be facing years behind bars for a crime he didn 't commit, while his seven children grow up without him and his wife Ryan-Marie is forced to raise their family alone. Not only that, but pro-life sidewalk counselors across the country may be deterred from going to the clinics out of concern that they, too, could end up in costly legal battles and even face federal charges simply for defending the unborn. So, I do ask that you make your gift as soon as you can. I've asked my staff to let me know as soon as we get your generous gift so I can let Mark know that you're standing with him. I know Mark and his family will be deeply touched by your generous support. May God bless you, Tom Brejcha President & Chief Counsel P.S. Biden's DOJ and Planned Parenthood want to destroy pro-life, father-of-seven Mark Houck and intimidate people of faith everywhere. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53619455/375971652/-863883417?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.29_b2_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGM5YmVjNy1jNzU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=apquDkZKY-oWb84Tsa7wSxlqq0dNtjx-9zYth4T0xx0=) Hi Derek,

With only 10 days left until Election Day, the excitement on the ground is at an all-time high. Things are getting busy, but I wanted to take a moment to share why I’m in this fight, and how I know that in less than two weeks, our [**people-powered campaign**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53619456/375971653/-863883417?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.29_b2_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGM5YmVjNy1jNzU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=apquDkZKY-oWb84Tsa7wSxlqq0dNtjx-9zYth4T0xx0=) will defeat right-wing extremism in western Pennsylvania.

_[**(But before I do: My team has been crunching the numbers, and right now we are $20,000 behind where we need to be to close out October. Can you chip in to help us head into the final stretch on a high note?)**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53619457/375971654/-863883417?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.29_b2_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGM5YmVjNy1jNzU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=apquDkZKY-oWb84Tsa7wSxlqq0dNtjx-9zYth4T0xx0=)_

I decided to run for Congress because I believe in fighting for our common good. **To me, common good means putting people first.**

It means having a government that builds the best infrastructure in the world, and having union workers build it. It means protecting the right to an abortion before we have right-wing legislatures banning it and putting women and doctors in prison. It means taking on communist China and keeping our jobs and industries in America. It means taking on the unchecked corporate power that’s killed our communities, hurt workers, and crushed small businesses. It means protecting the union way of life so that every worker in our region can form a union freely, with no more union-busting.

**My opponent, Jeremy Shaffer, has no answers for the problems we’re facing.** Shaffer and the radical right are all too happy to leave working folks behind, _because they care more about power than they care about all of us here in Western Pennsylvania._

**We are in the economic fight of our life, and western Pennsylvanians deserve better than corporate executive Jeremy Shaffer. I’m ready to rise to this occasion and fight for our common good.**

This passion comes from a simple place for me: I love this country – I was willing to die for it. **And I believe that an America that works for everyone is something worth fighting for.**

[**But here’s the tough truth, Derek: We’re being attacked on all sides by National Republicans and dark money groups who don’t want to challenge the power big corporations have in Washington. They’re spending millions to prop up Shaffer and defeat our people-powered team. Is there anything you can chip in to help us fight back?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53619458/375971655/-863883417?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.29_b2_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGM5YmVjNy1jNzU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=apquDkZKY-oWb84Tsa7wSxlqq0dNtjx-9zYth4T0xx0=)

Let’s make this country the land of hopes and dreams for all of us, and let’s get to work.

Thank you for your time,

Chris Deluzio | **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53619459/375971656/-863883417?refcode=em_fr_2022.10.29_b2_cd_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjOGM5YmVjNy1jNzU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=apquDkZKY-oWb84Tsa7wSxlqq0dNtjx-9zYth4T0xx0=)**

clean_body: Before things get too busy, I wanted to take a moment to share why I’m in this fight. | = Hi Derek, With only 10 days left until Election Day, the excitement on the ground is at an all-time high. Things are getting busy, but I wanted to take a moment to share why I’m in this fight, and how I know that in less than two weeks, our = will defeat right-wing extremism in western Pennsylvania. = I decided to run for Congress because I believe in fighting for our common good. To me, common good means putting people first. It means having a government that builds the best infrastructure in the world, and having union workers build it. It means protecting the right to an abortion before we have right-wing legislatures banning it and putting women and doctors in prison. It means taking on communist China and keeping our jobs and industries in America. It means taking on the unchecked corporate power that’s killed our communities, hurt workers, and crushed small businesses. It means protecting the union way of life so that every worker in our region can form a union freely, with no more union-busting. My opponent, Jeremy Shaffer, has no answers for the problems we’re facing. Shaffer and the radical right are all too happy to leave working folks behind, because they care more about power than they care about all of us here in Western Pennsylvania. We are in the economic fight of our life, and western Pennsylvanians deserve better than corporate executive Jeremy Shaffer. I’m ready to rise to this occasion and fight for our common good. This passion comes from a simple place for me: I love this country – I was willing to die for it. And I believe that an America that works for everyone is something worth fighting for. = Let’s make this country the land of hopes and dreams for all of us, and let’s get to work. Thank you for your time, Chris Deluzio | = | Chris Deluzio is a voting rights lawyer and Iraq war veteran running for Congress in Pennsylvania's 17th District. He'll be a champion for our unions, fight to guarantee good healthcare for every American, take on corporate power, and advocate for bold action to protect and strengthen our democracy. body:
| **Yesterday, President Obama and I just held a rally here in Georgia.** I’m so proud to have him on our side.

If you didn’t get a chance to watch, here’s what we want you to know: **Come Nov. 8, we’re going to win this race and keep Georgia blue.**

**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9h5bcghrlk8na7skjmon4u3v54rnt7fud45ali8_rp22sh2s8i66or7c1hm8o32c5h2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!

[Please help me fight for these peaceful January 6 protesters in court with your best gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbjt5rsrr1s1m3o6258eq6fshpbus4hujh14garg_rp22sh2s8i66or7c1hm8o32c5h2bs)

body:
I want to apologize for emailing you on a Saturday, but with just 10 days remaining in this election, this couldn’t wait. I know you are busy enjoying what’s left of your weekend, so I’ll try to be quick! |
---
Fellow Conservative

I want to apologize for emailing you twice in one day, but with just 10 days remaining in this election, this couldn’t wait. **Before you click out of this, or God forbid delete the message before reading it in its entirety, please know that your support at this critical juncture could mean the difference between another two years of DEM control in the House or helping it flip Republican.**

I’m nothing if not honest. I have my faults as we all do, but a liar I am not. You likely recall the email that I sent to you yesterday laying out in no uncertain terms that our fundraising this month hasn’t been good at all – in fact, Tuesday marked our single worst day of donations in the last six months. **As a result, a very generous benefactor offered to cut my campaign a check for $5,800 under the condition that I came up with an additional $5,800 from donors like you by midnight last evening**.

Hi team,

Last week, Ann took on her opponent Bryan Steil in a debate – and **_won_**.

Ann showed that without a doubt, she is the leader we need in office to deliver for the people of Wisconsin — while Bryan spouted out his party's rhetoric of misinformation to confuse and scare voters. **Here are just a few things that Bryan got wrong in the debate:**

1. He says he supports contraceptives, yet when put to a vote earlier this year, Bryan Steil **voted against** protections for contraceptives.
2. He called contraceptives a "chemical abortion pill". This **is completely false** and shows how Bryan Steil's misinformation is dangerous and puts women's lives at risk. Many people need birth control to treat life-threatening conditions and contraceptives help to do this.
3. He called student loan relief an "untargeted policy" for doctors and lawyers. This is false. The student loan relief is only eligible to those making less than $115k a year and cancels up to 20k in debt for those who need it. **The loan does not help elitist lawyers like Bryan Steil, and perhaps that is why he is so against the loan relief for others.**
4. He said that parents are losing their rights in our education system, but Ann is the only parent in this race. When Ann's children were in public school she consulted with the school district and knows **there are many avenues for parents to have input and involvement in their children's education.**
5. When speaking on 1st Amendment rights, Bryan claimed Governor Evers let Kenosha burn during the protests in 2020. **The Republican Sheriff of Kenosha County has said this is false**. Governor Evers authorized the support the Sheriff requested as soon as he asked.
6. And yet, despite Steil's grandstanding about supporting law enforcement, when Ann brought up that he voted against the January 6th investigation and voted against support for Capitol police, **he had no answers.**

Bryan Steil flopped on all the key issues, from the right to choose, to supporting our working class, to protecting medicare and social security. He has had four years to make a difference in Congress, but has failed to deliver for WI-01. **If we don't win in November, Bryan Steil will continue to put politics over real solutions that would help the people in our district.**

body:
I want to make sure you know just how important you are to this campaign.
#

I want to make sure you know just how important you are to this campaign.
When I think about our top supporters, I don’t think about the amount they gave. What means the most — what’s most important — is that folks step up for our campaign when we most need support.
Put simply, Republican outside groups would have drowned me out already with the over $63 million they are spending in North Carolina if this grassroots team had not had our back. Instead, we are tied and stand on the cusp of a historic victory because folks like you have come through when we needed you most.
I am so proud that we have funded our effort $5, $10, and $25 at a time. This is truly a people-powered campaign.
But one of the most important things I’ve learned running (and winning) statewide in North Carolina is it comes down to the margins. That was true when I won in 2014, and it was true in 2020 when 401 votes out of over 5 million decided my race for Chief Justice.
So our deadline in two days is another one of these important moments where we really need everyone who cares about this race and our Senate majority to stand with us. So I am humbly asking:
[**If you can afford it, will you please make a $10 donation to our campaign to flip North Carolina today? Every donation is going to make a difference in a race as close as this one.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221029-2-T1&t=1&akid=2167%2E357359%2EnFfmEL)

Derek,

After making a fortune on TV misleading his viewers for a living, New
Jersey resident Dr. Oz is once again trying to muddy the waters ahead of
Pennsylvania’s crucial U.S. Senate election on November 8th.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em_fetterman.wMzrmx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221029_PM1_V1_S1_VSP&email=&t=1004&akid=1221%2E5257348%2E1xHYSY ]Mehmet Oz says abortion should be decided between 'women, doctors, local
political leaders' during debate with John Fetterman

Dr. Oz wants the decision on abortion to be left to “women, doctors, and
local political leaders.” No, seriously. Local political leaders like the
right-wing candidate for governor of Pennsylvania who wants abortion
banned in all cases, without exceptions for rape or incest. Just what we
need when someone is facing such a difficult personal decision over their
health and future — a politician with a veto.

think that John Fetterman is responsible for crime. While John was mayor
of Braddock, a steel town ravaged by gun violence, he helped lead his
community through 5 1⁄2 years without a single gun death.

And Dr. Oz wants you to think that our democracy will be safe in his hands
in the United States Senate — while the few Congressional Republicans who
have taken Trump to task for his election lies will be packing their bags
and clearing out their Capitol Hill offices this January.

_**My opponent is a danger to America – that’s not an exaggeration.**_

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28]
Team,
We wanted to make sure you saw Elissa’s recent note on the cost of TV advertisements.
We’ve included it below so you can take a look, but essentially the race for Michigan’s new 7th district is the most expensive in the entire country. The best way we have to combat the millions of dollars spent and reserved against Elissa is by running our own ads to set the record straight – but that’s not cheap. In fact, it’s three times more expensive to run ads in the Lansing area than it was in 2020.
We weren’t expecting the cost of advertising to skyrocket, and in one of the most competitive House races in the country, staying up on TV is essential to our path to victory. Check out Elissa’s full email below, and please dig deep to help us continue to advertise for the next 12 days.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Team,
We’ve known all year that I’m running in one of the country’s most competitive House races — it’s a new district, filled with tens of thousands of new voters to meet, and only voted for President Biden by less than a percentage point. To that end, we knew we’d have to communicate early: my first TV ad aired on July 5, the earliest I’ve ever gone up on TV. We’ve released 9 ads since across our three media markets, Detroit, Lansing, and Flint, which you can watch here [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpZaVXq7xHeiFQTPBqFC4gQ] .
But in the last few weeks, these critical TV ads have gotten more expensive than we ever could have fathomed, even in a race this competitive.
The reach of a TV ad is measured in gross ratings points: ads need to reach about 1200-1500 points to really make a mark. And when we wrote our initial television budget, we knew based on 2018 and 2020’s races that the cost per point in our markets would go up exponentially — we figured, based on past races, that Detroit could get as high as $440 per point, and Lansing could go up to $150 per point.
2022 has been an election year like any other. Not only do we have competitive statewide and Congressional races, but *three* ballot initiatives fighting for time on the airwaves. Ad pricing is all supply and demand. The more demand there is for air time, the more ads cost.
So in Lansing? Our budget has nearly doubled — in the final week, it’s looking like we could pay nearly $300 per point. And in Detroit, which covers some of the most critical independent voters in our district? We’re being charged closer to $660 per point.
This is the most competitive House race in Michigan and one of the most competitive House races in the country — and the results are going to be close. Our path to victory requires staying on TV in the same rate we have been.
I’m asking if you’ll chip in today to help us maintain our television spending in our district: it’s expensive, but if we can stay on TV, we’ve got a shot to win. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221028&amount=28]
Elissa

subject: I’m in Arizona today campaigning for Senator Mark Kelly
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
I really respect and admire Sen. Kelly’s dedication to using science, data, and facts to address difficult problems
#

Hi friends,
I’m in Arizona today to help organize and get out the vote for my colleague Senator Mark Kelly.
[**Before I leave, can you help me show him that we have his back by splitting a contribution — of any amount — between our campaigns today?**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-kelly.eDubMy&refcode=em221029-1-60&t=1&akid=1109%2E159979%2EnGFknT)
**[SPLIT A DONATION](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-kelly.eDubMy&refcode=em221029-1-60&t=2&akid=1109%2E159979%2EnGFknT)**
Look, Arizona is going to be one of the most competitive (and expensive) Senate races in the entire country.
A recent poll shows Mark Kelly TIED with his MAGA-right opponent, and Cook Political Report recently updated their race rating for Arizona to TOSS-UP.
So it’s no surprise that Mitch McConnell and the NRSC, big-tech billionaire Peter Thiel, AND Trump’s Super PAC, MAGA Inc., have all poured millions of dollars into ads attacking Mark in the final stretch before Election Day.
**That’s why I’m in Arizona to support Mark Kelly, and it’s why I’m asking for your support to make sure he has the resources to win.**
[**If you can afford it, please split a $10 contribution between my campaign and Mark Kelly’s campaign in Arizona. Mark isn’t taking ANY corporate PAC money, so he’s counting on a lot of grassroots contributions to fight back against these attacks.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-kelly.eDubMy&refcode=em221029-1-60&t=3&akid=1109%2E159979%2EnGFknT)
**[SPLIT A DONATION](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-kelly.eDubMy&refcode=em221029-1-60&t=4&akid=1109%2E159979%2EnGFknT)**
Having been an engineer before I entered politics, I really respect and admire Sen. Kelly’s dedication to using science, data, and facts to address difficult problems, and I believe we need more people like that in Congress — especially when it comes to issues like climate change.
But if Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell get their way, he’ll be replaced with a Trump endorsee who calls abortion rights “demonic,” and wants to destroy Social Security.
So thank you in advance [**for anything you can afford to contribute today.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-oct22-kelly.eDubMy&refcode=em221029-1-60&t=5&akid=1109%2E159979%2EnGFknT) It will make a BIG difference in one of the closest Senate races in the country, and it would mean a lot to me and to Mark to know that you’re in this fight alongside us.
\- Alex

name: Kevin N.
subject: This is where we sprint.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
Good Afternoon, and Happy Saturday,

We get asked consistently where we are at on the campaign. Sometimes it is helpful to know where we started, and how we got to where we’re at. We started this race as a little-known candidate in Marquette and designed a strategy to boost name recognition, focus on bringing people together, and talk about stances that are important to the first district. We knew we would have to be aggressive from day one in traveling the district, talking with voters across all political ideologies, and reach out in every way we could to talk with them. 300 events later, we can proudly say that our strategy appears to be working.

Contribute $25 today to ensure we can maximize our outreach efforts through direct voter contact and expanding our television ads through election day.

It has been a lot of work over the last year, but we believe it is paying off. Our strategy focused on being extremely precise with who we were talking with, and used newly released, advanced digital tech to help us get our message in front of the specific people we wanted to see it. We knew every voter, every conversation, was going to be crucial to our success and anyone we needed to persuade was going to take every more convincing than usual this year.

As it stands now, we believe we are winning absentee votes, and have good reason to believe if we can fend off some of the major in person GOP votes by getting out our own voters, we will win. Anything could change between now and election day, that’s why every dollar is critical to our success. We need you in our corner now, more than ever before. Please donate any amount today.

The work up until now has mostly been long game strategy, building out teams across the district, boosting name recognition and letting people know who Dr. Bob is. In October, we launched our Bergman Accountability Project, following similar tactics in the district, ensuring “his” voters also know who Jack is, while continuing to focus conversations about Dr. Bob in a positive way. The last month is about to be done, and our final phase of our plan is this last-minute sprint to the finish on election day.

If it all plays out, we’ll win on November 8. That means we need every dollar to reach every voter with real conversations, and every ad needs to be fully funded to run through the end of November 8. Please donate whatever you can today to elect Pro-Choice, Pro-Democracy candidate to congress. A truth-teller and leader who will represent every person in Northern Michigan and the U.P.

Kevin N.
Campaign Manager

Peter, Ken Calvert likes to call himself a “fiscal conservative,” but his voting record shows otherwise. Calvert actually _supported_ a plan that raised taxes on California homeowners. Back when Trump was in office, Calvert championed the Republicans’ tax plan calling it a “step in the right direction.” That plan eliminated state and local tax deductions that Californians take -- increasing the tax bill for over 40% of his constituents. We need a leader who will actually help those of us struggling with inflation, and there’s no reason nurses, teachers, firefighters, and cops should be paying higher federal income tax rates than billionaires. Derek, you know me. I've prioritized serving our country and community my entire life.
| | |

Derek, you know me. I've prioritized serving our country and community my entire life. I've had the privilege of seeing people come together by the millions to take action for our nation. It's this belief in serving others, of using my life experiences to advocate for our community, that has been at the center of everything I do – including running as your representative again.
Over the past 10 months, I have been using my academic and professional background in supply chains to help craft plans and policies that fix our supply chains and reduce inflation. In fact, Forbes has called the plan I helped to write the "best inflation-fighting blueprint to come out of Congress yet." That’s the focus of our ad that you may have seen, “One Chip at a Time.”
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53621755/375981745/1540140954?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk728-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDAxMDEwOS1kNTU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DdL1ewh8Rs4boAhCv6wOfolXXMCt9BmwWP_bgrJ_duc=)
**As a Pennsylvanian and an entrepreneur who has a background in supply chains, I know that inflation is one of the most important issues facing our community today.** And our district is home to one of the foremost American computer chip manufacturers. That's why I worked with both parties to pass the Creating Helpful Incentives to Produce Semiconductors (CHIPS) and Science Act.

The bill supports domestic chip production, grows our STEM workforce, bolsters domestic 5G capabilities, and expands cutting-edge research and development. It will create jobs, lower costs, and reduce our reliance on China. I am proud of this legislation and will continue to reach across the aisle for the good of our community, our Commonwealth, and our country.
But my opponent and his allies are doing everything they can to keep us from continuing to build on our progress. And with House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy confirming that our district is a TOP target for this year's midterm elections, I need your help.

The truth is that I am up against an opponent who is out of step with our community and continues to run hyperbolic and dishonest attack ads in order to defeat me. In many ways, this race is about more than keeping this seat blue. It's about building a better future for all folks and families in PA-06.
**[Please, Derek, will you donate $5 today to help power our positive campaign to victory and keep this seat blue in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53621756/375981746/1540140954?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk728-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZDAxMDEwOS1kNTU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DdL1ewh8Rs4boAhCv6wOfolXXMCt9BmwWP_bgrJ_duc=)**
Thank you for your commitment to our fight.

There's work to be done.

Chrissy

---
Peter, for four generations my family has called Missouri our home. I was born here, I grew up here, I raised my kids here, and I served my community as a nurse and advocate here. **[Now, I'm about to ask you to make an investment in the future of this beautiful state. Can you give me a minute to explain why?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53622038/375982625/-1746441832?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk400-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YzdlN2RiOS1kNTU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ti0CzTTf5NUDxdvBG_OXcJxOzCRAyww2ueDqQ0OAjH4=)**
**After spending my entire life in this state, I can say this with my whole heart: I _love_ Missouri.**
The deep forests of the Ozarks in the south, the bountiful plains up north that stretch on endlessly and feed our families, the great Missouri River that runs through our state – Missouri is, without a doubt, absolutely beautiful. But the real reason I'll always call the Show Me State home is the vibrant, diverse communities who also call her home.
Whether in our great cities like St. Louis, Kansas City, and Jefferson City or the tight-knit rural towns like Chillicothe and St. James that dot our state, the people here are one of a kind.
Missourians are bold, fiercely independent, and deeply loyal (especially to our baseball teams). As our Show Me State nickname implies, we have a healthy level of skepticism, and we refuse to tolerate any nonsense. **But more than anything else, we will do anything to defend those we love.**
I love Missouri and the families within, and it's been the honor of a lifetime to serve them as a nurse, volunteer, and advocate. **But it breaks my heart to watch this state be sold out for a fat check from corporate lobbyists, to watch our values be tossed aside in favor of personal ambition, and to see our leaders choose partisanship over people.** We deserve so much better. That's why I'm running for Senate – to give families the leadership that embodies true Missouri values: integrity, independence, and compassion.
I promise you that I'm in this race for the right reasons, and you have my word that I'll deliver real change for your family in Washington. But I can't beat my MAGA opponent without your help. **[So please, Peter, with just days until the election, I'm personally asking: Will you invest in a better, brighter future, for Missouri and our whole country? name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Allow me just a moment to explain
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=bUI%2B%2F%2Fq0Ve6neQVRmf7pdq%2F83vlPKKik&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend - I'm facing a $23,991 shortfall ahead of the election's final end-of-month fundraising deadline, and I'm concerned I'll be short on resources in these final, crucial days.
I need to explain why I'm counting on you, one of this campaign's most engaged supporters, to chip in at this urgent moment.
The Republican Party has transformed into an extremist political movement completely beholden to a disgraced, twice-impeached former president. Candidates in major races for higher office - including my opponent - are sycophants for Trump's dangerous rhetoric and lies.
So if Democrats come up short by just one Senate seat, it doesn't _just_ mean handing over Senate control to Mitch McConnell. It means handing over control of the Senate to a band of extremists hell bent on trampling our democratic norms and stripping fundamental human rights from millions of American women.
That's why, as national Republicans have made me a target and Trump is fundraising for my opponent, I urgently need every member of this grassroots team to fight alongside me to protect this seat. **Indeed, it is YOUR donation that will ensure we can combat GOP attacks and win, protecting and EXPANDING Democratic Senate control.**
**[So please, will you donate $5 or more to protect this Democratic Senate seat and ensure control of the Senate stays out of the hands of Mitch McConnell? I need an immediate surge in grassroots donations to stay on track and win this race.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1284-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you,
Dick

name: John Fetterman
subject: Please, hear me out Derek
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I wouldn't be asking for your help with another fundraising goal if this wasn’t the most important Senate race in the country.
#
Hey Derek, I hate to email you this early on a Saturday, but...
**We are only TEN DAYS away from Election Day.** We’re almost in single digits, people!!!
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221029-7952&refcode2=7952_434096_koGf07&akid=7952%2E434096%2EkoGf07)
Which is why today, we’re launching our final end-of-month goal: **Raising $5 million by midnight on Halloween.**
**[Can you rush your very first donation of $5 today? I wouldn’t be asking if this wasn’t absolutely critical.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-2?refcode=em20221029-7952&refcode2=7952_434096_koGf07&akid=7952%2E434096%2EkoGf07)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221029-7952&refcode2=7952_434096_koGf07&akid=7952%2E434096%2EkoGf07)**
Listen, I know it feels like this campaign has been going on for a long time. I know we send a lot of emails. I know you’re probably getting emails from a lot of other candidates, too.
And here’s the truth: _I absolutely *hate* asking for money._
So believe me when I say, **I wouldn't be asking for your help with another fundraising goal if this wasn’t _the most important Senate race in the country._**
Abortion, voting rights, minimum wage: all of it is on the ballot this November. Dr. Oz has made it clear where he stands on these issues, Derek — _and it’s not with Pennsylvanians._
MAGA super PACs, including Donald Trump’s, + Dr. Oz have been funneling million$ of dollars into this race (as anyone in PA can tell you, watching TV is terrible right now 🙄).
In fact, Oz has officially dumped $27 million of his own money into this race — _making him the most self-funding candidate for federal office in the whole country._
Quite frankly, Derek, I can’t compete with that. I've spent the past two decades fighting for Braddock + average Pennsylvanians, not hawking snake oil on TV or tricking people into pyramid schemes.
**[Which is why I’m asking if you can be one of the first people to chip in and help us meet our final end-of-month fundraising goal of this campaign. We need as many of yinz + youse as possible to step up + donate if we’re going to meet this $5 million goal.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-2?refcode=em20221029-7952&refcode2=7952_434096_koGf07&akid=7952%2E434096%2EkoGf07)**
**[Rush a Donation »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221029-7952&refcode2=7952_434096_koGf07&akid=7952%2E434096%2EkoGf07)**
Your support means the absolute world to me, Gisele, + our entire campaign team.
Thank you,
John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate
P.S. PA residents counting down the days until all of Oz’s attack ads stop slamming the airwaves. 👇 **[Can you rush $5 today to help us fight back against all the attack ads?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221029-2?refcode=em20221029-7952&refcode2=7952_434096_koGf07&akid=7952%2E434096%2EkoGf07)**

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20221029-7952-footer&t=1&refcode2=7952_434096_koGf07&akid=7952%2E434096%2EkoGf07)**

This election is a once-in-a-generation moment. We've seen the next generation of women and girls of this state (including my daughter) be stripped of the basic right to make the most personal decisions about their bodies.

**We owe it to all the women who came before us, we owe it to our daughters, and we owe it to the next generation to fight like hell for our rights. That starts with voting out anti-choice extremists like Chris Carr — who think it's the place of the government to force rape victims to give birth.**

I know that a lot can happen in a generation. It was only one generation ago that I was growing up poor, the daughter of a single mother in rural Dodge County. I have seen both inspiring progress, and alarming movements to roll back our rights.

If we win on November 8, it will send an undeniable message to the forces who want to further limit bodily autonomy. But if we lose, they will be further emboldened.

[**So we're sparing no effort, and we need you with us. Please chip in to help us raise another $11,306 by the end of the month so that we can get our message out to as many Georgians as possible.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53607193/375952784/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221029EOM_N_JJ_FULL_7_G_N_L2&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzM1Njc0ZC1iNjU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=bELNFS9idOxsYUvkmtm5l84HRTj_V8leBAgUFmSnNL8=)

We've seen the next generation of women and girls of this state (including my daughter) be stripped of the basic right to make the most personal decisions about their bodies. We owe it to all the women who came before us, we owe it to our daughters, and we owe it to the next generation to fight like hell for our rights. That starts with voting out anti-choice extremists like Chris Carr — who think it's the place of the government to force rape victims to give birth. I know that a lot can happen in a generation. It was only one generation ago that I was growing up poor, the daughter of a single mother in rural Dodge County. I have seen both inspiring progress, and alarming movements to roll back our rights. If we win on November 8, it will send an undeniable message to the forces who want to further limit bodily autonomy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T062c9f86-4bee-47c9-b31f-5523aae148cb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

Younger voters HAVE ALREADY MADE THE DIFFERENCE THIS ELECTION. The record-breaking turnout among younger voters and women in Kansas is credited with destroying a Death Star in Kansas, the referendum attempting to ban all abortion. With its defeat by a whopping 18$, I think we can successfully say that Death Star was destroyed.** **_But if we know anything about Death Stars--and the Right Wing in this country--they're always building more._** I'm not saying any of this to be dramatic, I save that for onscreen. This is for real. They're trying to take away our rights--to choose, whom to love, what books our kids read, the safety of our children inside schools and outside in our climate--RIGHT NOW. Without high turnout from young voters, the fate of our future will be sealed. **_So with the 2022 midterm election only 10 days away, Voters of Tomorrow's voter registration efforts are more important than ever. They will register every last voter, which in some states continues right up through election day._** Registering one new voter costs $4.38, and they're still hoping to register more than 5,000 new voters by the election - that’s $21,900! [**So today, I'm asking you to chip in $22 to help fund their General Election Fund so they can ramp up voter registration efforts. Friend, I know that this close to Election Day, you're probably getting bombarded by the latest polls and expert predictions. **So today, I wanted to take a moment to share my story and tell you why I'm running for reelection in the first place.**
I’m humbled to represent Georgia in the Senate as its first-ever Black senator. Growing up in public housing, my family was short on money but long on love and faith. Through hard work and the support of my community, I became the first in my family to graduate from college, then went on to become the senior pastor at Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s church. **Now, thanks to this grassroots team, I'm fighting in the Senate to make sure every child __ can achieve their American dream.**

clean_body: Find out what Nikki has been up to this week...| | | | | | | | | | | | IOWA On Tuesday, Nikki Haley joined a bus tour with Gov. Kim Reynolds, Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks, Rep. Ashley Hinson, and Brenna Bird in a final campaign push before Election Day. The Winning For Women bus tour was a huge success. They were joined by hundreds of supporters in Davenport and Cedar Rapids who rallied behind these great candidates. Nikki recorded a few special video messages with some of the candidates on the road. If you’d like to donate to any of them please consider pitching in below. | | | | | | | | | | | PENNSYLVANIA Nikki Haley also made stops in Pennsylvania this week. She joined Dr. Oz as he unveiled his platform to tackle the rising crime crisis. Dr. Oz’s opponent, John Fetterman, has a terrible record on crime. As lieutenant governor, he voted to release more than a dozen convicted murderers and wants to release one-third of Pennsylvania’s prisoners. Nikki also campaigned with Lisa Scheller who is facing a tough race in PA-07. She recorded a video with Dr. Oz and Lisa Scheller to update you on the state of their races. Watch the videos below and consider chipping in to their campaigns today. | | | | | - | | | | NEW JERSEY | | | In 2020, Democrat Tom Malinowski won NJ-07 by just 1.2 points. It was 19 months ago when the power grid — which Greg Abbott had been warned about — absolutely failed us. The lights went out, the heat stopped running, and the water stopped flowing because it was frozen in the pipes for millions of Texans. More than 700 people died — of hypothermia, carbon monoxide poisoning in their garages, and burning up in their homes as they set fire to their furniture trying to keep their kids warm.

During this crisis, Abbott pegged the price of electricity at its highest allowable rate for days and gas soon started trading at 200 times what it had sold for before. **Abbott's biggest campaign contributors ended up making billions of dollars over the course of those five days.** The kicker is that after all that happened, the grid is still not fixed, and we are all paying higher electricity and utility bills as a result.

This governor failed the most basic job of government, to keep the lights on in the energy capital of the world. Add to that that we now lead the nation in the number of school shootings, and that gun violence is now the leading cause of death for kids and teenagers in the state of Texas.

This week marks 22 weeks since 19 kids and their two amazing teachers were killed in their classrooms by an 18-year-old who could legally buy not one but two AR-15s and hundreds of rounds of ammunition. Five of the worst mass shootings in U.S. history have happened in the last five years, and the only thing that Abbott has done is make it easier for people who shouldn't have a weapon to buy a gun and carry them openly on our streets.

What may be most galvanizing for millions in this state is the extreme abortion ban that Abbott signed into law that just went into effect in August. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. | | President Obama just called on Democrats to wholeheartedly commit themselves to the final stretch of this election. _**And Democrats responded.**_ The very moment President Obama started speaking in Michigan, Democrats all over the country decided to get off the sidelines – _pouring in gifts_ to show how many of us are fighting alongside him. Take a look for yourself: [](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953xJdM4UPBsteMLVkfmLiDV3QMM2Z9ALdAe8O1qfEG41sUkmL-4uIYdCLF2P0DkhDamKYxSa1e5joLixKzV8ja_w7YlGBYhhI-jk60FefD8UtpOh1RU019ls7HI57A-WOtywskHo8Tkf28s9M8_F3ZELaNG6NxFNccFKb_qPDrQf78yeJcG09-bwitK9ttIbEHcz1jiXJ_aa5CaeAOMaVB-oDX2-5ZB-seHALF7E8y0UQGoBU-u49GPVZib9xuU-1JyEvOyhoEdUVwd0QNBLuGHYMEuxXI6U39Uy8KkPidtzs9H43-Mbw8jBXeU57ZuOiie002r4JuuP-PbomiW_399qPn7fiFw7z93tTVgzHhAP-mvirKdc0JG06sGFxVP2NidUO0mer4iMSTcoFEehlGSo/3qp/_uqPsO63TzC6gqi0dh7aLQ/h0/gngJXeE8y-sqY9A5_HpT90_SN6nbXaSmr-G5MUx-E6A) To capitalize on this moment, a coalition of generous donors is 5X-MATCHING every grassroots gift! Hello,

**Our democracy is worth fighting for!** My name is Jeanne Hendricks and I'm running to defeat GOP U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer in Minnesota's 6th Congressional District.

In the latest good news for my campaign, U.S. Rep. Angie Craig and U.S. Rep. Dean Phillips have endorsed my campaign to become Minnesota's 6th District next U.S. Rep.

I'm a mom, nurse, and the Democratic nominee for U.S. Congress in Minnesota's 6th. I make decisions every day based on science and facts. That's more than I can say about my opponent, **Tom Emmer.**

As chair of the National Republican Congressional Committee, GOP U.S. Rep. Tom Emmer is the person in DC whose job is to **spearhead and fund the reelections of extremist candidates like Matt Gaetz, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and Lauren Boebert.**

Emmer has an atrocious record on women's rights, opposing not just reproductive freedoms in all cases, but also voting against the Violence Against Women Act and against Pay Equity. **Just this month on Fox News,****Emmer called abortions********" Chinese genocide,"****and was described by Huffington Post as somehow managing "to be both sexist and racist" in only two words.**

I will fight for women's rights, to lower inflation, to create family wage-paying jobs, for labor unions, to pass more common-sense gun safety legislation, to lower health care costs, for climate change solutions, and to defend our democracy.

**Emmer is an enabler for far-right MAGA Republicans and does not represent Minnesotan values. I need your help to defeat Tom Emmer and the extremists threatening our country.**

[**Click here to donate to defeat Rep. Emmer and strike a blow against the NRCC 's extremist candidates across the country.**](https://cmtd1.com/c/443/f8f1999b28b1dca9252d97ea50fcccb16a6d8b1b62050fd8c2a38769ad565ab65f79f2a0e700feaf)

body:
We missed our $5,800 goal yesterday by just $716. We're getting on more chance to redeem our $5,800 match, but we have to hit our goal by 11:59 p.m. I know you are busy enjoying what’s left of your weekend, so I’ll try to be quick! |

Peter

I want to apologize for emailing you twice in one day, but with just 10 days remaining in this election, this couldn’t wait. **Before you click out of this, or God forbid delete the message before reading it in its entirety, please know that your support at this critical juncture could mean the difference between another two years of DEM control in the House or helping it flip Republican.**

I’m nothing if not honest. I have my faults as we all do, but a liar I am not. You likely recall the email that I sent to you yesterday laying out in no uncertain terms that our fundraising this month hasn’t been good at all – in fact, Tuesday marked our single worst day of donations in the last six months. **As a result, a very generous benefactor offered to cut my campaign a check for $5,800 under the condition that I came up with an additional $5,800 from donors like you by midnight last evening**.
**
We failed. In the end, we came up short by $716.[[link to donate]](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=c71f932aa1f84c2b9a29c40a5c9500cd&_e=M6bzX_Yi1URfGInDV8CiOT-VVk6iTGcNsQy0ztHQUW6-xKIjBAaP0bgVxdB_qIL1Eyyway6AAChpNCEj3SbsAe9dP_9iV0vePzpy_47C6gbSp2BKQDNjDy6vt4oPERSLdVBDvBz8CeSqzEm6dh2iToABnJU8QsfbGcr8RUtcZIbPdE90GeDlkoUn1T1Tn7dtmnr0Yt1nUfwuAm7-X9HdY8VMDyRicMul0iCKwqlCVfq2SQZZGhuunfoYVcrFzMcorQ7l2eFohtz6WgKmbJTXEFavgQk_6MKqz94gYj2ogmHfOvDi2IK8mNavs-L0Z831FYuJiETUUt-oGPwgJ-C3jOwtKw-8wL3FQ0QEcSuS5P6-Jc8U1myV8k7FTw7rpsx5UsfVlDVfMv-VlRfGJsd4xg%3D%3D) **

All is not lost – yet. The donor, who wishes to remain anonymous, has agreed to give us one more shot at winning his support. If we can come up with the additional $716 by midnight tonight, he’ll follow through with his part of the bargain and cut us the $5,800 check.

Friends –

I've spent more than four decades making films that tell America’s stories, and examining the crises – internal and external – that we have faced as a nation, including threats to our democracy.
From the Civil War to the Great Depression, from the First and Second World Wars to the COVID-19 pandemic, these crises have challenged us to live up to the essential promise of our nation, preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant, the democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."

That’s why I’m reaching out. With a 50-50 split in the Senate, the fate of our Democratic majority—and our very democracy—hinges on what happens in New Hampshire.
Maggie Hassan is a vital voice in the Senate, and we cannot afford to lose her tireless work on behalf of Granite Staters—and in fact all Americans. This November, she's up against a far-right election denier who believes a woman’s most personal decisions about abortion—decisions about her own body—belong in the hands of Republican “gentlemen” lawmakers.
Our country stands at a crossroads, and it's up to us to decide which direction we’ll take. Either we plunge down the path of extremism that Maggie's opponent has taken, or we choose the other way—the higher road—and come together to support leaders like Maggie who will fight to protect our future.
Maggie won her last race by just 1,017 votes. That was one of the closest margins in American history. And Republicans are targeting her race with $55 million in attack ads. With just 10 days left until the election, we need to have the resources necessary to turn out every last vote.
**[So I'm asking you now, friend: will you help meet this moment by pitching in to Maggie Hassan's reelection campaign today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53618633/375967488/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1970-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNmQwM2Q0Ny1jNDU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DEXSkbg0mxr4Ak_03uE1syPlUJn_DOkD2kZmhr-Zq1I=)**
With Washington divided, I believe that Maggie is the person we need to help bridge the gulf between the two parties, wider now and more divisive than I have ever seen. It's incumbent on us to redouble our efforts and dig a little deeper to ensure that Maggie has the support she needs to be reelected.
**[Please, join me in supporting Maggie by chipping in what you can. The stakes have never been higher.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53618634/375967492/-947982778?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1970-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNmQwM2Q0Ny1jNDU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DEXSkbg0mxr4Ak_03uE1syPlUJn_DOkD2kZmhr-Zq1I=)**

Ken

As a legislator, she’s fought for affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation's most progressive paid family leave bill. I was just in Oregon this month to help Andrea, and let me tell you — Andrea is the real deal, and if she can beat her anti-democratic Republican opponent, she’s going to be a real force in Congress. Her opponent wants to throw out the election before it even happens. Sheesh. Andrea is facing a critical end-of-month deadline on Monday at midnight. Now that we are seeing the early votes come in and the last minute polling, we’re understanding that this race is closer than we even thought. Years of the poor Democrat representation have taken their toll on this community and now the people are ready for a change.As gas spikes to record levels and crime is out of control, the years-long “vote blue no matter who” mentality has been broken — and I’m confident that in ten days we will win. But, that victory is going to require your help.

She hugs the Left flank of the party tightly and votes along with it almost every single time. She's voted for gun control, said nothing as Biden destroyed our economy and has forgotten all about the communities in her district that desperately need her help.My district is crying out for help. body:

When I debated Marco Rubio, I hope I made you proud, Derek. It was an honor to share my vision for a better, more just America on the stage -- an America where a poor, Black girl like me could grow up to one day run for U.S. Senate. Peter,
We’re writing to give you an update on the developing, extremely serious situation and possible national security threat in Karina’s opponent’s office: **News broke yesterday that Karina’s opponent's Congressional office staff have significant ties to the Chinese embassy.**
[](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=6998689a06&e=22db41c18e)
**Don Beyer has been compromised. Our district houses the Pentagon and the C.I.A. The reality is that he is no longer fit to hold office.** Karina spent 14 years in the U.S. defense/intelligence communities, and it’s very clear that the reports of China ties in Rep. Beyer's office are a serious problem. This must be investigated thoroughly by law enforcement and Congress.Beyer is on committees with international tax and trade jurisdiction and access to sensitive information. **Don Beyer has set tax and trade policy impacting solar imports from China. He has drafted and passed laws governing semiconductor chips and electric vehicle batteries using materials mined in China. Don Beyer is too close to China and way too far apart from the values of Northern Virginia.** Virginia’s 8th Congressional District is is full of current and former national security professionals. We have the Pentagon, and the CIA. We have many defense contractors. **This district, probably more than any other, keeps America safe. We can't afford to have a question mark in office representing us.** Karina has held top-level security clearances for over a decade. She’s [ready on Day One](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=a9d0e9042c&e=22db41c18e) to step in and effectively represent this district and she shared her serious concerns with the Washington Times in the below article.
[](https://karinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5169078bc3370360935103e65&id=c52b3bd0fe&e=22db41c18e)
Karina has spent this campaign telling Northern Virginia voters why she would be better at the job than Beyer. This is just the latest example.It’s time for change - it’s time for Karina. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.
