After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

| | **29October2022**

**Two Issues in Under 400 Words**
1. **I joined two friends on their podcast, Patriot State Radio, and they recently posted an interview of two remarkable women who have earned the moniker, “Covid Angels”. They traveled the state over the last year – at their own expense – offering help and remedies for Covid and other illnesses with very positive results. Annie and Fran were first interviewed in December 2021, then earlier this month they asked to come back to offer updates on other home remedies and protocols. It was fascinating and enlightening. I encourage you to listen to Episode 45 on PatriotStateRadio.org. Given the deceit we have seen from our government regarding, well, just about everything they are involved in, it is imperative to have outside information on what we can do to protect ourselves from future events.**

**PatriotStateRadio.org Episode 45**

2. **Many voters have contacted me to advise they would be writing in my name for US Senate in the November 8th general election. The reason they most frequently provide is that being Pro-Life matters, and the “republican” candidate on the ballot is not Pro-Life.**

**They have a powerful point, and it brings to mind the battle we waged on the floor of the Colorado House last session – the longest floor fight in state history – fighting a radical pro-abortion bill. It took conservatives to plan and lead that fight. We fought it for God, Country, and the Unborn, and there should never be equivocation in such battles. Alas, there is too much equivocating in the party when it will not even adhere to or uphold the Pro-Life plank of its platform.**

**I have advised against writing in my name – because that vote will not be counted. Instead, those voters can cast a recorded vote for the only Pro-Life candidate on the US Senate ballot – Libertarian Brian Peotter. Doing so, coupled with the massive numbers of voters who intend to leave many or all of the statewide races blank, will send a powerful message: the Republican Party needs to stand firm in its principles. True Republicans stand firmly on our platform and speak resolutely. Phony Republicans shape-shift and pander, then pump bilge and sleaze. The American voter can see the difference.**

**Praying for a CONSERVATIVE Red Wave in our great nation,**

**Ron Hanks**
**Representative, House District 60**

| Well, I must admit I’d never heard this one before.

Stephen Colbert called my Republican opponent “the kookiest, zaniest, conspiracy wacko this side of nutso Banana Junction.” I’m not one for name calling, but Colbert is right. [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/31384?t=6&akid=5117%2E878179%2E-uflIj) Don Bolduc wants to defund the Department of Homeland Security, abolish the Department of Education, and is even open to getting rid of the FBI. **Top Republican outside groups have doubled down on their commitment to flipping New Hampshire, and the latest polling shows me tied with Don Bolduc.**

Peter,

I know Vish emailed you this morning, but this campaign MUST raise $250,000 more online before October 31 to make sure we surge in the final days of this race.
The newest poll shows me **down by just 3 points** ... and that a **_massive_ _17%_ of voters** have NOT picked between me or Josh Shapiro yet.
Fact is, the Media thought they could trick people into thinking I’m something I’m not... but **as their narrative falls apart (both in my race, and in the PA Senate race), people are taking a second look.**

name: Brittany Pettersen
subject: Thank you, thank you, thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brittany Pettersen for Colorado
body:
Grateful for you, friend

Team — running for office is a humbling experience in a lot of ways. But the most humbling thing of all is the trust the people in this community have put in me to fight for our future, and how many of you have sacrificed time, energy, and hard-earned money to ensure a victory on election night. So I just wanted to reach out and say, from the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU. We’ve still got 10 days to go to win this thing. Every single day, Republicans are attacking me with everything they’ve got. And recent polling shows this race is going to come down to the wire. **I want you to know that I fully understand the stakes of this campaign. I understand that our basic rights, even our democracy, are on the line. And that’s why I’m working night and day to make my case to the people of this community. I’m not taking anything or anyone for granted.** So with that in mind, I need to ask for your support once again. You’ve given our campaign a lot, my friend, and I am so appreciative. But we can’t afford to lose an inch of ground and still win this race, and that means we need more resources to air our ads and reach out to voters. **[We have our final monthly fundraising deadline of the campaign in just 48 hours. If you could make a donation of any amount to help us catch up to our goal, it would mean the world to me.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53622335/375983867/-1064909629?refcode=email_102922_thankyou&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNkMWQ4Ny1kODU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Dc09NkMA3sAABmonZDYqDF0aN5Ty8oWm97SNF-szznY=)** | | [DONATE → ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53622336/375983868/-1064909629?refcode=email_102922_thankyou&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTNkMWQ4Ny1kODU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Dc09NkMA3sAABmonZDYqDF0aN5Ty8oWm97SNF-szznY=)

I would like to personally say thank you.

Thank you for fighting by my side as we face yet another battleground race that will decide Senate control. Your support is truly making all the difference.

In fact, because of this team's grassroots support, **a recent poll shows us surging ahead of Herschel Walker in these critical final days of our campaign.**

But with _barely_ a week until Election Day, I simply can't cross the finish line without your continued support. Here's why:

We're currently getting outspent by the GOP, whose super PACs have been spending $5 million _every week_ to defeat me. Even worse, _FiveThirtyEight_ reports that Democrats won't be able to confidently hold our Senate majority if we lose in Georgia. **The future of our democracy is on the line.**

**We owe it to all the women who came before us, we owe it to our daughters, and we owe it to the next generation to fight like hell for our rights. That starts with voting out anti-choice extremists like Chris Carr — who think it's the place of the government to force rape victims to give birth.**

I know that a lot can happen in a generation. It was only one generation ago that I was growing up poor, the daughter of a single mother in rural Dodge County. I have seen both inspiring progress, and alarming movements to roll back our rights.

If we win on November 8, it will send an undeniable message to the forces who want to further limit bodily autonomy. But if we lose, they will be further emboldened.

[**So we're sparing no effort, and we need you with us. Please chip in to help us raise another $11,306 by the end of the month so that we can get our message out to as many Georgians as possible.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53622877/375985683/1460579386?refcode=EM_FR_221029EOM2_N_MS_FULL_10_G_N_L3&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzQ3ZjRiYS1kYzU3LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WkXbhbnquqJIbQQ3sHaDUufKve7f66SrZwGYmR6Ehfg=)

Friend,

I’m writing to explain how we’ve shifted our work at the NDRC in response to escalating Republican attacks on our democracy. (This is a long email, so if you don’t have time to read it all but would like to contribute, you can [**_give at this link_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53623558/375988579/693620013?amount=30&refcode=20221029.4r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMzYWJiZDZkLWRkNTctZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WWIn7O_LH28HIMwKy96DhTRVK32nMVw8mW4zz9GC7KM=).)

With the support of President Obama, former Attorney General Eric Holder launched the NDRC in 2017 to address the persistent problem of Republican gerrymandering. As MSNBC’s Joy Reid put it: “**Eric Holder... made it his mission literally to protect our democracy** and to execute a redistricting strategy that helps rebalance power.”

We had a lot of success with our strategy. By starting years before redistricting kicked off, we helped win elections, built a robust grassroots network, and mobilized record levels of public engagement in the redistricting process – leading to the fairest congressional districts in 40 years, according to _The New York Times_!

But redistricting has always been part of the larger fight to protect our democracy – and with MAGA election deniers running for and _in danger of winning_ key offices, the threat to our fundamental system of government is even greater.

**That’s why the NDRC is applying our successful redistricting approach to shine a spotlight on races that are essential to protecting our democracy.**
[**_The last end of month deadline before Election Day is just two days away.
Will you support all of our work?_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53623559/375988580/693620013?amount=30&refcode=20221029.4r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMzYWJiZDZkLWRkNTctZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WWIn7O_LH28HIMwKy96DhTRVK32nMVw8mW4zz9GC7KM=)
What does this entail? It means we’re supporting:
★ 13 candidates running for governor,
★ 5 for secretary of state,
★ 1 for state auditor,
★ and more than 400 for state legislature – _all of whom could be the last line of defense against the dismantling of our democracy._
(This is on top of our work to preserve and expand access to voting and protect election infrastructure and administration across the country. [**_Please chip in to support us._**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/53623560/375988581/693620013?amount=30&refcode=20221029.4r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjMzYWJiZDZkLWRkNTctZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WWIn7O_LH28HIMwKy96DhTRVK32nMVw8mW4zz9GC7KM=))

Here’s the thing: Like all of our work over the past five years, this effort will only be successful with the help of our grassroots community. **The LAST end of month deadline before Election Day is just two days away.** It’s never been a more important time to give.

subject: Volunteer tomorrow to help John Fetterman win
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
This is the *single* most important time you can volunteer.
#
Knock, Knock.
Is this Derek? We need your help! 😁
**We’re urgently looking for 10 more volunteers from Cresco to sign up for a friendbanking shift or a door knocking shift this weekend to elect John Fetterman.**
Friendbanking (aka rallying up your friends who vote) and knocking on doors for John are the TWO most important things you can do right now to talk to voters and ensure that John wins on Election Day.
_Even one volunteer shift from Cresco can make all the difference._
[**Can John Fetterman count on you to sign up for an upcoming friendbank or door knocking shift? Team Fetterman staff are on deck to help first-time volunteers get started.**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49397?t=1&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)
**[RSVP: Friendbanking](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49397?t=2&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)** | **[RSVP: Door Knocking](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49466?t=3&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)**
---|---
The great thing about volunteering is that it’s fun and easy. You can do it from just about anywhere.
You can volunteer from your phone.
[
](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49397?t=4&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)
You can volunteer from your computer.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49466?t=5&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)
Heck, you can even volunteer in the middle of a Pittsburgh snowstorm in shorts.
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49397?t=6&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)
John will fight for everyday Pennsylvanians and be the 51st vote in the Senate, BUT we can't do it without a broad coalition of folks in Cresco and all 67 Counties.
**[Right now is the *single* most important time to volunteer with our campaign. Will you RSVP to an upcoming shift of knocking doors or friendbanking right now?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49397?t=7&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)**
**[RSVP: Friendbanking](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49397?t=8&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)** | **[RSVP: Door Knocking](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/49466?t=9&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)**
---|---
Thanks, and see you out there.
— Team Fetterman HQ 💛

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20221029-7957-footer&t=19&refcode2=7957_434096_96qbME&akid=7957%2E434096%2E96qbME)**
---
[](https://www.facebook.com/JohnFettermanPA/) | [](https://twitter.com/johnfetterman) | [](https://www.instagram.com/johnfetterman/)
Email us: info@johnfetterman.com
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way we keep in touch with people like you, so thank you for reading to the end. Small donors like you keep us going. To contribute via check, please address to Fetterman for PA, PO Box 6061, Pittsburgh PA 15211.
